cards.name: Ice and Death
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the shelter value of your location (rounded up).
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (if you cannot, take 1 horror).
[tablet]: -3. For each point you fail by, discard the top card of your deck. Draw each weakness discarded by this effect.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：–X。X為你所在地點的庇護值的一半(向上取整)。
[cultist]：–2。如果你檢定失敗，將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，不要查看內容(如果你不能這麼做，受到1點恐懼)。
[tablet]：–3。你檢定失敗且每低於難度1點，丟棄你牌堆頂的1張卡牌。抽取所有以此效果棄掉的弱點。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the shelter value of your location.
[cultist]: -2. For each point you fail by, shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (for each card you cannot shuffle, take 1 horror).
[tablet]: -4. For each point you fail by, discard the top card of your deck. Draw each weakness discarded by this effect.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：–X。X為你所在地點的庇護值。
[cultist]：–2。你檢定失敗且每低於難度1點，將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，不要查看內容(每有1張卡牌不能混洗入你的牌堆，受到1點恐懼)。
[tablet]：–4。你檢定失敗且每低於難度1點，丟棄你牌堆頂的1張卡牌。抽取所有以此效果棄掉的弱點。

cards.name: Crash Site
cards.text: [action]: Test [intellect] or [agility] (3) to scavenge from the wreckage. If you succeed, in the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log, record Spare Parts. (Max one success per campaign.) Shelter 0.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[intellect]或[agility](3)以在殘骸中搜尋。如果你檢定成功，在劇本日誌"已回收的補給品"中，記錄備用零件(每個劇本最多一次成功)。 庇護0。

cards.name: Frozen Shores
cards.text: Frozen Shores gets +2 shroud if an encounter card is attached to it. Shelter 2.
cards.text_cn: 如果有遭遇卡牌疊加到冰凍海岸，冰凍海岸得到+2隱藏值。 庇護2。

cards.name: Treacherous Path
cards.text: Forced - After you reveal 1 or more [frost] tokens during a skill test at Treacherous Path: Take 1 damage or horror for each [frost] token revealed. Shelter 1.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 位於危險道路的技能檢定期間，在你抽出[frost]標記後：每抽出一個[frost]標記，受到1點傷害。 庇護1。

cards.name: Precarious Ice Sheet
cards.text: [reaction] When you draw a [[Hazard]] treachery while at Precarious Ice Sheet, add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag: Cancel that card's effects and discard it. (Group limit once per round.) Shelter 2.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你在不穩定冰蓋抽出一張[[危險]]詭計時，在混亂袋裡加入1個[frost]標記：取消該卡牌的效果並將其丟棄。(團隊每輪限制一次)。 庇護2。

cards.name: Broad Snowdrifts
cards.text: [reaction] When you successfully investigate Broad Snowdrifts, add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag: Discover 3 additional clues at Broad Snowdrifts. (Group limit once per game.) Shelter 4.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你成功調查遼闊雪地時，在混亂袋裡加入1個[frost]標記：發現遼闊雪地額外3個線索。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次)。 庇護4。
cards.back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
cards.back_text_cn: 作為你進入本地點的額外費用，你所在地點的調查員必須共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索。

cards.name: Icy Wastes
cards.text: Treat the modifier of the first [frost] token revealed during each skill test at Icy Wastes as -3, instead of -1. Shelter 4.
cards.text_cn: 在冰封荒原的每次技能檢定期間，改為將揭示的第一個[frost]標記的修正值視為–3，而不是–1。 庇護4。
cards.back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
cards.back_text_cn: 作為你進入本地點的額外費用，你所在地點的調查員必須共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索。

cards.name: Rocky Crags
cards.text: Forced - When a treachery is attached to Rocky Crags: That treachery gains surge. (Max once per phase.) Shelter 3.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在一張詭計疊加到岩石峭壁時：該詭計獲得湧動(每階段限制一次)。 庇護3。
cards.back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
cards.back_text_cn: 作為你進入本地點的額外費用，你所在地點的調查員必須共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索。

cards.name: Snow Graves
cards.text: [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Snow Graves, shuffle the top 3 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at them: In the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log, record Green Soapstone. (Group limit once per campaign.) Shelter 5.
cards.text_cn: [reaction]在你發現雪塚的最後一個線索後，忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的3張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，不要查看內容：在劇本日誌"已回收的補給品"中，記錄綠皂石(團隊每個劇本限制一次)。 庇護5。
cards.back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
cards.back_text_cn: 作為你進入本地點的額外費用，你所在地點的調查員必須共同花費2[per_investigator]個線索。

cards.name: Icebreaker Landing
cards.text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (4) to search the trapped ship for supplies. If you succeed, either remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag or record Small Radio in the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log. (Max one success per campaign.) Shelter 5.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。檢定[intellect](4)來搜索被困船隻，尋找補給品。如果你檢定成功，移除混亂袋中的1個[frost]標記，或在劇本日誌"已回收的補給品"中，記錄小型收音機。(每個劇本最多一次成功)。 庇護5。
cards.back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
cards.back_text_cn: 作為你進入本地點的額外費用，你所在地點的調查員必須共同花費2[per_investigator]個線索。

cards.name: Frigid Cave
cards.text: [action] Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag: In the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log, record Mineral Specimen. (Group limit once per campaign.) Shelter 6.
cards.text_cn: [action]在混亂袋裡加入1個[frost]標記：在劇本日誌"已回收的補給品"中，記錄礦物標本(團隊每個劇本限制一次)。 庇護6。
cards.back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 2 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
cards.back_text_cn: 作為你進入本地點的額外費用，你所在地點的調查員必須共同花費2[per_investigator]個線索。

cards.name: Barrier Camp
cards.text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (4) to convince some of the other explorers here to give you something useful. If you succeed, in the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log, record Dynamite. (Max one success per campaign.) Shelter 7.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。檢定[willpower](4)來說服這兒的其他探索者給你一些有用的東西。如果你檢定成功，在劇本日誌"已回收的補給品"中，記錄炸藥(每個劇本最多一次成功)。 庇護7。
cards.back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
cards.back_text_cn: 作為你進入本地點的額外費用，你所在地點的調查員必須共同花費4[per_investigator]個線索。

cards.name: Remnants of Lake's Camp
cards.text: [action]: Test [combat] (4) to dig through the snow in search of supplies. If you succeed, in the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log, record Wooden Sledge. (Max one success per campaign.) Shelter 7.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[combat](4)來挖掘雪地以尋找補給。如果你檢定成功，在劇本日誌"已回收的補給品"中，記錄木製雪橇。(每個劇本最多一次成功)。 庇護7。
cards.back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
cards.back_text_cn: 作為你進入本地點的額外費用，你所在地點的調查員必須共同花費4[per_investigator]個線索。

cards.name: Crystalline Cavern
cards.text: [action]: Test [agility] (5) to climb up one of the crystalline walls in search of evidence. If you succeed, in the "Supplies Recovered" section of the Campaign Log, record Miasmic Crystal. (Max one success per campaign.) Shelter 8.
cards.text_cn: [action]：檢定[agility](5)來爬上其中一面水晶牆以尋找證據。 如果你檢定成功，在劇本日誌"已回收的補給品"中，記錄瘴氣水晶(每個劇本最多一次成功)。 庇護9。
cards.back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter this location, investigators at your location must spend 4 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
cards.back_text_cn: 作為你進入本地點的額外費用，你所在地點的調查員必須共同花費4[per_investigator]個線索。

cards.name: Skittering Nonsense
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - When you defeat Skittering Nonsense: Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (if you cannot, Skittering Nonsense attacks you).
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 – 在你擊敗疾行謬物時：將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，不要查看內容(如果你不能這麼做，疾行謬物攻擊你)。

cards.name: Apeirophobia
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (X), where X is your location's shelter value. If you fail, you must decide (choose one): - Take 1 horror for each point you failed by. - Place 2 of your clues on your location. - Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 檢定[willpower](X)，X為你所在地點的庇護值。如果你檢定失敗，你必須決定(選擇一項)： - 每低於難度1點，受到1點恐懼。 - 將你的2個線索放到你所在地點。 - 在混亂袋裡加入1個[frost]標記。

cards.name: Zero Visibility
cards.text: Revelation - Put Zero Visibility into play in your threat area. As an additional cost for you to leave a location with a treachery attached to it, you must spend 1 action. Forced - At the end of your turn: Test [agility] (2). If you succeed, discard Zero Visibility.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 將零能見度放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 作為離開有疊加詭計的地點的額外費用，你必須花費1個行動。 強制 – 當你的回合結束時：檢定[agility](2)。如果你檢定成功，丟棄零能見度。

cards.name: Cold Welcome
cards.text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在調查員第一次進入一個地點後：將放在一邊的地點中，所有與該地點相連的地點放置入場。(參考劇本手冊中的地圖擺放)。
cards.back_text: Spawn a set-aside Skittering Nonsense at the lead investigator's location. Shuffle the remainder of the set-aside Skittering Nonsense enemies and the set-aside Creatures in the Ice encounter set into the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 在調查員隊長所在地點生成一個放在一邊的疾行謬物。將剩餘的放在一邊的疾行謬物敵人，以及放在一邊的冰中生物遭遇組混洗入遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Into the White
cards.text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在調查員第一次進入一個地點後：將放在一邊的地點中，所有與該地點相連的地點放置入場。(參考劇本手冊中的地圖擺放)。
cards.back_text: Spawn the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy at the revealed location with the highest shelter value.
cards.back_text_cn: 在已揭示的庇護值最高的地點生成放在一邊的星之恐怖敵人。

cards.name: Running Out of Time
cards.text: Forced - After a location is entered by an investigator for the first time: Put into play each set-aside location connected to that location. (Use the map in the Campaign Guide for reference.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在調查員第一次進入一個地點後：將放在一邊的地點中，所有與該地點相連的地點放置入場。(參考劇本手冊中的地圖擺放)。
cards.back_text: Each investigator, including those who are eliminated, shuffles the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck. Choose a location in play with no clues on it. Each undefeated investigator moves to that location and immediately resigns. The higher that location's shelter value, the better. If the investigators cannot choose such a location, they must move to the Crash Site and immediately resign, even if they otherwise could not. (Then, resolve the [[Objective]] on act 1a.)
cards.back_text_cn: 每位調查員(包括已退場的)將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌混洗入自己的牌堆。 選擇場上一個沒有線索的地點。每位沒有被擊敗的調查員移動到該地點並立即撤退。該地點的庇護值越高越好。如果調查員沒有對應地點可選擇，則移動到墜機點並立即撤退，無論是否可能。(然後，結算場景la上的目標)。

cards.name: Search for a Camp Site
cards.text: [action] If each investigator is at the same location and that location has no clues on it: Resign. You set up camp. Each investigator resigns. Objective - Find somewhere safe to set up camp. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance. The higher the shelter value of the location they resigned at, the better.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果所有調查員都在同一地點，且該地點上沒有線索：撤退。你紮起了營。所有調查員撤退。 目標 – 找到安全的地方紮營。如果所有未被擊敗的調查員都撤退了，推進場景。他們撤退的地點的庇護值越高越好。

cards.name: Terror of the Stars
cards.text:
Hunter. Massive.
Terror of the Stars gets +3 [per_investigator] health.
While Terror of the Stars is ready, investigators cannot resign at its location or discover clues at its location.
cards.text_cn:
獵手。 龐大。
星之恐怖得到+3[per_investigator]生命值。
星之恐怖處於準備狀態時，調查員不能在星之恐怖所在地點撤退，或發現星之恐怖所在地點的線索。

cards.name: A Harsh Wind Blows
cards.back_text: Choose a facedown encounter card beneath a location. Look at the other side of that card (without resolving its text). Then return it facedown beneath that location.
cards.back_text_cn: 選擇在一個地點底下的一張正面朝下的遭遇卡牌。查看該卡牌正面(不要結算其文字)。然後將其正面朝下放回該地點底下。

cards.name: The Chill of Night
cards.back_text: Choose a facedown encounter card beneath a location. Look at the other side of that card (without resolving its text). Then return it facedown beneath that location.
cards.back_text_cn: 選擇在一個地點底下的一張正面朝下的遭遇卡牌。查看該卡牌正面(不要結算其文字)。然後將其正面朝下放回該地點底下。

cards.name: Madness and Death
cards.back_text: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. (→R1)
cards.back_text_cn: 剩下的每位調查員被擊敗並受到1點精神創傷。 (→結局1)

cards.name: The Lost Expedition
cards.text: [fast] Investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Draw the encounter card beneath your location. [action] If you are at camp: Resign. You turn in for the night. Objective - Find as many missing expedition members as you can by adding them to the victory display, then head back to camp before daybreak. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.text_cn: [fast]你所在地點的調查員共同花費[per_investigator]個線索：抽取你所在地點底下的遭遇卡牌。 [action]如果你位於營地：撤退。你回來渡過夜晚。 目標 – 找到盡可能多的失蹤探險隊成員(將其加入勝利區)，然後在黎明到來前回到營地。如果所有未被擊敗的調查員都撤退了，推進場景。

cards.name: Dead End
cards.text:
Remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag.
Add this story card to the victory display.
cards.text_cn:
從混亂袋裡移除1個[frost]標記。
將本劇情卡牌加入勝利區。

cards.name: Cracks in the Ice
cards.text:
Search your deck for a copy of Tekeli-li and place it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
cards.text_cn:
查找你的牌堆，找出一張忒咳哩-哩並將其放到忒咳哩-哩牌堆底，不要結算它。混洗你的牌堆。
將本劇情卡牌加入勝利區。

cards.name: Somber Remains
cards.text:
Search the top 9 cards of your deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and place each one you find on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
cards.text_cn:
查找你牌堆頂的9張卡牌，找出其中所有忒咳哩-哩，並將這些卡牌都放在忒咳哩-哩牌堆底，不要結算它們。混洗你的牌堆。
將本劇情卡牌加入勝利區。

cards.name: Disappearing Footprints
cards.text:
Remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag.
Add this story card to the victory display.
cards.text_cn:
從混亂袋裡移除1個[frost]標記。
將本劇情卡牌加入勝利區。

cards.name: Dissected Explorer
cards.text:
Search your deck for a copy of Tekeli-li and place it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
cards.text_cn:
查找你的牌堆，找出一張忒咳哩-哩並將其放到忒咳哩-哩牌堆底，不要結算它。混洗你的牌堆。
將本劇情卡牌加入勝利區。

cards.name: Evil Within
cards.text:
Discard an [[Eidolon]] enemy that does not have the [[Elite]] trait from play.
Add this story card to the victory display.
cards.text_cn:
從場上丟棄一個非[[精英]]屬性的[[幻靈]]敵人。
將本劇情卡牌加入勝利區。

cards.name: Bloody Evidence
cards.text:
Search the top 9 cards of your deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and place each one you find on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck without resolving it. Shuffle your deck.
Add this story card to the victory display.
cards.text_cn:
查找你牌堆頂的9張卡牌，找出其中所有忒咳哩-哩，並將這些卡牌都放在忒咳哩-哩牌堆底，不要結算它們。混洗你的牌堆。
將本劇情卡牌加入勝利區。

cards.name: Madness Inside
cards.text:
Choose a [[Possessed]] enemy in play that does not have the [[Elite]] trait. Take control of each doom on that enemy, flipping them to their clue sides. Discard the chosen enemy.
Add this story card to the victory display.
cards.text_cn:
選擇場上一個非[[精英]]屬性的[[附身]]敵人。控制該敵人上所有毀滅標記，並將其翻到線索面。丟棄選擇的敵人。
將本劇情卡牌加入勝利區。

cards.name: Professor William Dyer
cards.text: [action] Choose and discard up to 2 cards from your hand: Parley. Place that many resources on Professor William Dyer (from the token bank). If there are 3 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Professor William Dyer is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.
cards.text_cn: [action]從你的手中選擇並丟棄最多2張卡牌：談判。將相等數量的資源(從供應堆拿取)放在威廉·戴爾教授上。如果其上有3[per_investigator]資源，將其加入勝利區。 強制 – 如果威廉·戴爾教授被擊敗：在劇本日誌上劃掉其名字。

cards.name: Danforth
cards.text: [action]: Parley. You listen closely to Danforth's rambling. Draw up to 2 cards from the top of the Tekeli-li deck. Then, place that many resources on Danforth (from the token pool). If there are 3 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Danforth is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。你仔細聽丹佛斯的胡言亂語。抽取忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂最多2張卡牌。然後，將相等數量的資源(從供應堆拿取)放在丹佛斯上。如果其上有3[per_investigator]資源，將其加入勝利區。 強制 – 如果丹佛斯被擊敗：在劇本日誌上劃掉其名字。

cards.name: Eliyah Ashevak
cards.text: [action]: Parley. Test [agility] (2) to sneak by Anyu and speak with Eliyah. For each point you succeed by, place 1 resource on him (from the token pool). If you fail, he attacks you. If there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Eliyah Ashevak is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。檢定[agility](2)以偷偷溜過安雨，並與伊里亞交談。你檢定成功且每超過難度1點，在其上放1資源(從供應堆拿取)。如果你檢定失敗，其攻擊你。如果其上有2[per_investigator]資源，將其加入勝利區。 強制 – 如果伊里亞·阿什瓦克被擊敗：在劇本日誌上劃掉其名字。

cards.name: Dr. Mala Sinha
cards.text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (2) to attempt to calm Dr. Sinha down. For each point you succeed by, place 1 resource on her (from the token pool). If you fail, she attacks you. If there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on her, add her to the victory display. Forced - If Dr. Mala Sinha is defeated: Cross her name off in the Campaign Log.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。檢定[willpower](2)以試圖讓辛哈醫生冷靜下來。你檢定成功且每超過難度1點，在其上放1資源(從供應堆拿取)。如果你檢定失敗，其攻擊你。如果其上有2[per_investigator]資源，將其加入勝利區。 強制 – 如果瑪拉·辛哈醫生被擊敗：在劇本日誌上劃掉其名字。

cards.name: Avery Claypool
cards.text: [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (5) to get Claypool to stop babbling nonsense. If you succeed, place 1 resource on him (from the token pool). If you fail, he attacks you. If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Avery Claypool is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。檢定[willpower]或[intellect](5)以使克萊普爾停止胡言亂語。如果你檢定成功，在其上放1資源(從供應堆拿取)。如果你檢定失敗，其攻擊你。如果其上有1[per_investigator]資源，將其加入勝利區。 強制 – 如果艾弗里·克萊普爾被擊敗：在劇本日誌上劃掉其名字。

cards.name: James "Cookie" Fredericks
cards.name_cn: 詹姆斯·"曲奇"·弗雷德里克斯
cards.text: Retaliate. [action]: Parley. Test [combat] (2) to wrestle the gun away from Cookie. For each point you succeed by, place 1 resource on him (from the token pool). If you fail, he attacks you. If there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If James "Cookie" Fredericks is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.
cards.text_cn: 反擊。 [action]：談判。檢定[combat](2)以奪走曲奇的槍。你檢定成功且每超過難度1點，在其上放1資源(從供應堆拿取)。如果你檢定失敗，其攻擊你。如果其上有2[per_investigator]資源，將其加入勝利區。 強制 – 如果詹姆斯·"曲奇"·弗雷德里克斯被擊敗：在劇本日誌上劃掉其名字。

cards.name: Dr. Amy Kensler
cards.text: [action]: Parley. Test [intellect] (2) to convince Dr. Kensler to tell you what she has seen. For each point you succeed by, place 1 resource on her (from the token pool). If you fail, she attacks you. If there are 2 [per_investigator] resources on her, add her to the victory display. Forced - If Dr. Amy Kensler is defeated: Cross her name off in the Campaign Log.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。檢定[intellect](2)以說服肯斯勒博士將她看到的東西都告訴你。你檢定成功且每超過難度1點，在其上放1資源(從供應堆拿取)。如果你檢定失敗，其攻擊你。如果其上有2[per_investigator]資源，將其加入勝利區。 強制 – 如果艾米·肯斯勒博士被擊敗：在劇本日誌上劃掉其名字。

cards.name: Roald Ellsworth
cards.text: [action]: Parley. Test [combat] or [agility] (5) to get Ellsworth to let go of the strange rock he is clutching. If you succeed, place 1 resource on him (from the token pool). If you fail, he attacks you. If there are 1 [per_investigator] resources on him, add him to the victory display. Forced - If Roald Ellsworth is defeated: Cross his name off in the Campaign Log.
cards.text_cn: [action]：談判。檢定[combat]或[agility](5)以使埃爾斯沃思放下手裡的奇怪石頭。如果你檢定成功，在其上放1資源(從供應堆拿取)。如果你檢定失敗，其攻擊你。如果其上有1[per_investigator]資源，將其加入勝利區。 強制 – 如果羅爾德·埃爾斯沃思被擊敗：在劇本日誌上劃掉其名字。

cards.name: Takada Hiroko
cards.text: [action] Spend up to 3 resources: Parley. Place each of these resources on Takada Hiroko. If there are 5 [per_investigator] resources on her, add her to the victory display. Forced - If Takada Hiroko is defeated: Cross her name off in the Campaign Log.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費最多3資源：談判。將花費的所有資源放到高田弘子上。如果其上有5[per_investigator]資源，將其加入勝利區。 強制 – 如果高田弘子被擊敗：在劇本日誌上劃掉其名字。

cards.name: Manifestations of Evil
cards.text: Forced - When this agenda would advance, if there is at least 1 facedown card beneath a Seeping Nightmare: Instead of advancing this agenda, remove 2 doom from play and find the Seeping Nightmare with the most facedown cards beneath it. Choose one of the cards beneath it at random and spawn it at its location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在本密謀將要推進時，如果在滲出夢魘底下有至少1張正面朝下的卡牌：不推進密謀，改為從場上移除2個毀滅標記，並找到底下有最多正面朝下卡牌的滲出夢魘。隨機選擇其底下的1張卡牌，並生成在其所在地點。
cards.back_text:
The lead investigator must decide (choose one):
- Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag.
- In player order, each investigator shuffles the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck (each investigator who cannot takes 1 damage and 1 horror instead).
cards.back_text_cn:
調查員隊長必須決定(選擇一項)：
- 在混亂袋裡加入1個[frost]標記。
- 按玩家順序，每位調查員將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的2張卡牌混洗入自己的牌堆(每位不能這麼做的調查員改為受到1點傷害和1點恐懼)。

cards.name: Icy Depths
cards.back_text: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 physical trauma.
cards.back_text_cn: 剩下的每位調查員被擊敗並受到1點肉體創傷。

cards.name: Under Attack!
cards.text: Each [[Eidolon]] enemy gains Victory 0. The camp gains: "[action] Investigators at your location spend 4 clues, as a group: Resign." Objective - If there are no [[Eidolon]] enemies in play, advance. Objective - If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.text_cn: 每個[[幻靈]]敵人獲得勝利0。 營地獲得："[action]你所在地點的調查員共同花費4個線索：撤退。" 目標 – 如果場上沒有[[幻靈]]敵人，推進場景。 目標 – 如果所有未被擊敗的調查員都撤退了，推進場景。
cards.back_text:
If there are no [[Eidolon]] enemies in play:
The last of the nightmarish creatures falls, its miasmatic body at once dissolving into inky, prismatic liquid and dissipating into wisps of gray mist filled with screaming shapes. Then, silence.
(→R1)
If the investigators advanced by resigning:
You follow a makeshift path through a jagged split in the ice shelf, making your way deeper into the mainland, toward the mountains. You don't know if these creatures can follow human tracks - or indeed if they need tracks at all in order to pursue you - but you take the time to cover them, regardless. Hopefully, with this shortcut you've found, you'll be safe...
(→R2)
cards.back_text_cn:
如果場上沒有[[幻靈]]敵人：
最後的可怕生物倒下了，它瘴氣似的身體立刻融化成墨色的柱狀液體，消散成一縷縷形狀詭異的灰色霧氣。然後，一切歸於沉寂。
(→結局1)
如果調查員通過撤退來推進場景：
你沿著一條簡易小路穿過冰架的鋸齒狀裂縫，進入大陸深處，走向山脈。你不知道這些生物是否會跟隨人類的足跡——或者它們是否需要人類的足跡來追趕你——但無論如何，你都要花時間來掩蓋它們。希望有了這條你找到的捷徑，你會變安全些……
(→結局2)

cards.name: Seeping Nightmare
cards.text: While an [[Eidolon]] enemy at Seeping Nightmare's location is moving, its location is considered connected to the camp. While there are no facedown cards beneath Seeping Nightmare, it gains hunter. Forced - When Seeping Nightmare is defeated: Remove each facedown card beneath it from the game.
cards.text_cn: 位於滲出夢魘所在地點的[[幻靈]]敵人移動時，其所在地點視為與營地相連。 滲出夢魘底下沒有正面朝下的卡牌時，其獲得獵手。 強制 – 在滲出夢魘被擊敗時：將其底下的所有正面朝下的卡牌從遊戲中移除。

cards.name: Phantasmagoria
cards.text: Revelation - If there are no Seeping Nightmares in play, Phantasmagoria gains surge. Otherwise, find the Seeping Nightmare nearest to an investigator. If there are 1 or more cards beneath it, choose one of them at random and spawn it at its location. If there are no cards beneath it, it moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase (without exhausting).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 如果場上沒有滲出夢魘，千變幻景獲得湧動。否則，找到離一位調查員最近的滲出夢魘。如果其底下有至少1張卡牌，隨機選擇其中一張並將該卡牌生成在其所在地點。如果其底下沒有卡牌，則其移動並攻擊，如同在敵軍階段(但不要消耗)。

cards.name: Fatal Mirage
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of story cards in the victory display.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, you must either move to the Prison of Memories, or shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, place 1 doom on an [[Eidolon]] enemy in play.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：–X。X為勝利區中劇情卡牌的數量。
[cultist]：–2。如果你檢定失敗，將你的1個線索放到你所在地點。
[tablet]：–3。如果你檢定失敗，你必須移動到記憶囚籠，或將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，不要查看內容。
[elder_thing]：–4。如果你檢定失敗，在場上一個[[幻靈]]敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the current agenda number plus the number of story cards in the victory display.
[cultist]: -2. If you do not succeed by at least 2, place 1 of your clues on your location.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, you must either move to the Prison of Memories, or shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it. (If you fail by 2 or more, do both instead.)
[elder_thing]: -5. If you fail, place 1 doom on an [[Eidolon]] enemy in play.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：–X。X為當前密謀編號加上勝利區中劇情卡牌的數量。
[cultist]：–2。如果你沒有檢定成功且超過難度至少2點，將你的1個線索放到你所在地點。
[tablet]：–4。如果你檢定失敗，你必須移動到記憶囚籠，或將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，不要查看內容。(如果你檢定失敗且低於難度至少2點，改為兩項都執行)。
[elder_thing]：–5。如果你檢定失敗，在場上一個[[幻靈]]敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。

cards.name: Ethereal Tangle (v. I)
cards.text: [fast] Take 1 horror: Move to the Prison of Memories.
cards.text_cn: [fast] 受到1點恐懼：移動到記憶囚籠。
cards.back_text: Each remaining investigator is defeated and must shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 剩餘的每位調查員被擊敗，且必須將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌混洗入自己的牌堆。

cards.name: Ethereal Tangle (v. II)
cards.text: [fast] Take 1 horror: Move to the Prison of Memories.
cards.text_cn: [fast] 受到1點恐懼：移動到記憶囚籠。
cards.back_text: Each remaining investigator is defeated and must either suffer 1 mental trauma or shuffle the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 剩餘的每位調查員被擊敗，且必須受到1點精神創傷，或者將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的2張卡牌混洗入自己的牌堆。

cards.name: Ethereal Tangle (v. III)
cards.text: [fast] Take 1 horror: Move to the Prison of Memories.
cards.text_cn: [fast] 受到1點恐懼：移動到記憶囚籠。
cards.back_text: Each remaining investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma.
cards.back_text_cn: 剩餘的每位調查員被擊敗並受到1點精神創傷。

cards.name: Shadow of the Past (v. I)
cards.text: Objective - Confront your demons to strengthen your resolve. (Hint: You may have more than one opportunity to advance this act. Until then, you are trapped. If you are running out of time and are given the chance to advance, consider taking it...)
cards.text_cn: 目標 – 直面內心的惡魔，堅定你的決心。(提示：你可能有不止一次機會來推進本場景。在那之前，你都被困住了。如果你在時限將盡時正好可以推進，不妨考慮抓住機會……)

cards.name: Prison of Memories
cards.text:
Mirage 1 [per_investigator] (Base Camp, Deck of the Theodosia, University Halls).
X is the current agenda number.
cards.text_cn:
幻景1[per_investigator](大本營、菲奧多西亞號甲板、大學禮堂)。
X為當前密謀編號。

cards.name: Base Camp
cards.text:
Mirage 1 [per_investigator] (Coastal Waters, Deserted Station, Riverview Theatre).
[reaction] When you would you fail a skill test by exactly 1 while investigating Base Camp, take 1 horror: You get +1 skill value for this test.
cards.text_cn:
幻景1[per_investigator](沿海水域、荒廢車站、河景劇院)。
[reaction]你調查大本營時，在技能檢定將要失敗且正好低於難度1點時，受到1點恐懼：你本次檢定得到+1技能值。

cards.name: Deck of the Theodosia
cards.text: Mirage 1 [per_investigator] (Coastal Waters, Hedge Maze, Standing Stones). Forced - When you investigate Deck of the Theodosia: You must either give it +2 shroud for this investigation, or spend 1 additional action to investigate it.
cards.text_cn: 幻景1[per_investigator](沿海水域、樹籬迷宮、聳立岩石)。 強制 – 在你調查菲奧多西亞號甲板時：你必須使其在本次調查中得到+2隱藏值，或者額外花費1個行動來調查。

cards.name: University Halls
cards.text: Mirage 1 [per_investigator] (Elder Chamber, Riverview Theatre, Standing Stones). Forced - When University Halls is flipped over: Each investigator discards the top 3 cards of their deck for each clue they spent. Each investigator draws each Tekeli-li weakness they discarded in this way. Shuffle each other weakness discarded in this way back into its owner's deck.
cards.text_cn: 幻景1[per_investigator](古老者廳室、河景劇院、聳立岩石)。 強制 – 在大學禮堂翻面時：每位調查員每花費一個線索，丟棄自己牌堆頂3張卡牌。每位調查員抽取自己以此方式棄掉的所有忒咳哩-哩弱點弱點。將其他所有以此方式棄掉的弱點混洗回所有者牌堆。

cards.name: Hedge Maze
cards.text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Mo'ai Statues). Forced - After you investigate Hedge Maze during your turn: Increase its shroud value by 1 until the end of your turn. You cannot leave Hedge Maze this turn.
cards.text_cn: 幻景2[per_investigator](摩艾石像)。 強制 – 你回合期間，在你調查樹籬迷宮後：直到你的回合結束，其隱藏值增加1點。本回合你不能離開樹籬迷宮。

cards.name: Deserted Station
cards.text:
Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Alaskan Wilds).
Deserted Station gets +3 shroud while there is at least one treachery attached to it.
cards.text_cn:
幻景2[per_investigator](阿拉斯加荒野)。
荒廢車站有疊加詭計時，得到+3隱藏值。

cards.name: Coastal Waters
cards.text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Airfield, Ottoman Front). Forced - After you reveal a [frost] token while investigating Coastal Waters: Take 1 horror. If this investigation is successful, discover 1 additional clue at Coastal Waters. (Limit once per test.)
cards.text_cn: 幻景2[per_investigator](飛機場、奧斯曼前線)。 強制 – 你調查沿海水域時，在你揭示一個[frost]標記後：受到1點恐懼。如果本次調查成功，發現沿海水域額外1個線索。(每次檢定限制一次。)

cards.name: Elder Chamber
cards.text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Cluttered Dormitory). Forced - After you discover 2 or more clues from Elder Chamber during a single investigation or card effect: Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck.
cards.text_cn: 幻景2[per_investigator](凌亂宿舍)。 強制 – 單獨一次調查或卡牌效果期間，在你從古老者廳室發現至少2個線索後：將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的一張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆庫。

cards.name: Riverview Theatre
cards.text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Dr. Kensler's Office, Infirmary). Forced - When you draw a Tekeli-li card while at Riverview Theatre: Resolve its effects an additional time. Then, discover 1 clue at Riverview Theatre.
cards.text_cn: 幻景2[per_investigator](肯斯勒博士的辦公室、醫務室)。 強制 – 你在河景劇院抽取1張忒咳哩-哩卡牌時：額外結算一次其效果。然後，發現河景劇院的1個線索。

cards.name: Standing Stones
cards.text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (The Black Stone, Dyer's Classroom). Forced - After you reveal a [frost] token while investigating Standing Stones: Take 1 damage. If this investigation is successful, discover 1 additional clue at Standing Stones. (Limit once per test.)
cards.text_cn: 幻景2[per_investigator](黑色岩石、戴爾的教室)。 強制 – 你調查聳立岩石時，在你揭示一個[frost]後：受到1點傷害。如果本次調查成功，發現聳立岩石額外1個線索。(每次檢定限制一次。)

cards.name: Airfield
cards.text:
Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of a Missing Father).
While Takada Hiroko is at this location, it gets -2 shroud.
As an additional cost for you to investigate Airfield, you must spend 1 resource.
cards.text_cn:
幻景2[per_investigator](失蹤父親之記憶)。
高田弘子在本地點時，本地點得到–2隱藏。
作為調查飛機場的額外費用飛機場，你必須花費1資源。

cards.name: Alaskan Wilds
cards.text:
Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of a Hunt Gone Awry).
While Eliyah Ashevak is at this location, it gets -2 shroud.
As an additional cost for you to enter Alaskan Wilds, you must either shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck, or spend 1 action.
cards.text_cn:
幻景2[per_investigator](狩獵失敗之記憶)。
伊里亞·阿什瓦克在本地點時，本地點得到–2隱藏。
作為你進入阿拉斯加荒野的額外費用，你必須將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的一張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，或者花費1個行動。

cards.name: Cluttered Dormitory
cards.text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of an Unspeakable Evil). While Danforth is at this location, it gets -2 shroud. Forced - When you resolve the revelation ability on a Tekeli-li card while at Cluttered Dormitory: Shuffle it back into your deck instead of placing it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.
cards.text_cn: 幻景2[per_investigator](無法述說的惡魔之記憶)。 丹佛斯在本地點時，本地點得到–2隱藏。 強制 – 在你位於淩亂宿舍結算忒咳哩-哩卡牌上的顯現能力時：不要將其放到忒咳哩-哩牌堆底，改為混洗回你的牌堆。

cards.name: Dyer's Classroom
cards.text:
Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of a Regretful Voyage).
While Professor William Dyer is at this location, it gets -2 shroud.
[action] Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck: Heal 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at this location.
cards.text_cn:
幻景2[per_investigator](悔恨航程之記憶)。
威廉·戴爾教授在本地點時，本地點得到–2隱藏。
[action]將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的一張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆：治癒本地點的一位調查員或一個[[盟友]]支援1點恐懼。

cards.name: Infirmary
cards.text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of a Lost Patient). While Dr. Mala Sinha is at this location, it gets -2 shroud. Forced - After you enter Infirmary for the first time this game, if you have more than 6 remaining health: Take damage until you have exactly 6 remaining health. Otherwise, take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 幻景2[per_investigatpr](去世病人之記憶)。 瑪拉·辛哈醫生在本地點時，本地點得到–2隱藏。 強制 – 在本場遊戲你第一次進入醫務室後，如果你的剩餘生命值超過6點：受到傷害直到你有正好6點剩餘生命值。否則，受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Dr. Kensler's Office
cards.text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of an Unrequited Love). While Dr. Amy Kensler is at this location, it gets -2 shroud. Forced - After you successfully investigate Dr. Kensler's Office: You must either take 1 horror, or remove 1 secret from an asset you control.
cards.text_cn: 幻景2[per_investigator](單戀之記憶)。 艾米·肯斯勒博士在本地點時，本地點得到–2隱藏。 強制 – 在你成功調查肯斯勒博士的辦公室後：你必須受到1點恐懼，或移除你控制的一個支援的1秘密。

cards.name: Mo'ai Statues
cards.text: Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of an Alien Translation). While Roald Ellsworth is at this location, it gets -2 shroud. Forced - When the revelation effect of a treachery attaches it to Mo'ai Statues: That treachery gains surge. (Limit once per phase.)
cards.text_cn: 幻景2[per_investigator](翻譯異星文字之記憶)。 羅爾德·埃爾斯沃思在本地點時，本地點得到–2隱藏。 強制 – 在詭計卡牌的顯現效果將其疊加到摩艾石像時：該詭計獲得湧動(每階段限制一次)。

cards.name: Ottoman Front
cards.text:
Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of a Ravaged Country).
While James "Cookie" Fredericks is at this location, it gets -2 shroud.
Each non-[[Elite]] enemy at Ottoman Front gets +2 fight and loses retaliate.
cards.text_cn:
幻景2[per_investigator](飽經戰亂的國家之記憶)。
詹姆斯·"曲奇"·弗雷德里克斯在本地點時，本地點得到–2隱藏。
位於奧斯曼前線的每個非[[精英]]敵人得到+2攻擊，並失去反擊。

cards.name: The Black Stone
cards.text:
Mirage 2 [per_investigator] (Memory of a Terrible Discovery).
While Avery Claypool is at this location, it gets -2 shroud.
[fast] Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag: Discover 2 clues at The Black Stone. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn:
幻景2[per_investigator](可怕發現之記憶)。
艾弗里·克萊普爾在本地點時，本地點得到–2隱藏。
[fast]在混亂袋裡加入1個[frost]標記：發現黑色岩石的2個線索(團隊每場遊戲限制一次)。

cards.name: Memory of a Hunt Gone Awry
cards.text: Alert. Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with Eliyah Ashevak. [reaction] After you successfully evade this enemy by 3 or more: Deal it 3 damage. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: 警戒。反擊。 獵物 – 擁有伊里亞·阿什瓦克的調查員。 [reaction]在你成功躲避本敵人，且超過難度至少3點後：對其造成3點傷害。 強制 – 在本敵人被擊敗時：將其翻面並結算另一面的文本。

cards.name: Memory of a Lost Patient
cards.text: Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with Dr. Mala Sinha. [reaction] After you heal 1 or more damage while this enemy is exhausted: Deal that much damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: 反擊。 獵物 – 擁有瑪拉·辛哈醫生的調查員。 [reaction]本敵人處於消耗狀態時，在你治癒1點或更多傷害後：對本敵人造成該數量的傷害。 強制 – 在本敵人被擊敗時：將其翻面並結算另一面的文本。

cards.name: Memory of a Missing Father
cards.text: Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with Takada Hiroko. [reaction] After you gain 1 or more resources while this enemy is exhausted: Deal 1 damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: 反擊。 獵物 – 擁有高田弘子的調查員。 [reaction]本敵人處於橫置狀態時，在你獲得資源後：對本敵人造成1點傷害。 強制 – 在本敵人被擊敗時：將其翻面並結算另一面的文本。

cards.name: Memory of a Ravaged Country
cards.name_cn: 飽經戰亂的國家之記憶
cards.text: Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with James "Cookie" Fredericks. [reaction] After this enemy attacks you: Deal it 1 damage. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: 反擊。 獵物 – 擁有詹姆斯·"曲奇"·弗雷德里克斯的調查員。 [reaction]本敵人攻擊你後：對其造成1點傷害。 強制 – 在本敵人被擊敗時：將其翻面並結算另一面的文本。

cards.name: Memory of a Regretful Voyage
cards.text: Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with Dr. William Dyer. [reaction] After you draw 1 or more cards while this enemy is exhausted: Deal that much damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: 反擊。 獵物 – 擁有威廉·戴爾博士的調查員。 [reaction]本敵人處於消耗狀態時，在你抽取1張或更多卡牌後：對本敵人造成該數量的傷害。 強制 – 在本敵人被擊敗時：將其翻面並結算另一面的文本。

cards.name: Memory of an Unspeakable Evil
cards.name_cn: 無法述說的惡魔之記憶
cards.text: Alert. Retaliate. Prey - Investigator with Danforth. [action][action] Shuffle the top 3 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck: Parley. Deal 3 damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: 警戒。反擊。 獵物 – 擁有丹佛斯的調查員。 [action][action]將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的3張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆：談判。對本敵人造成3點傷害。 強制 – 在本敵人被擊敗時：將其翻面並結算另一面的文本。

cards.name: Memory of a Terrible Discovery
cards.text: Alert. Prey - Investigator with Avery Claypool. [action] Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag: Parley. Deal 4 damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: 警戒。 獵物 – 擁有艾弗里·克萊普爾的調查員。 [action]在混亂袋裡加入1個[frost]標記：談判。對本敵人造成4點傷害。 強制 – 在本敵人被擊敗時：將其翻面並結算另一面的文本。

cards.name: Memory of an Alien Translation
cards.text: Alert. Prey - Investigator with Roald Ellsworth. [reaction] After this enemy is exhausted, if there is an attachment on its location: Deal 4 damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: 警戒。 獵物 – 擁有羅爾德·埃爾斯沃思的調查員。 [reaction]在本敵人被消耗後，如果在其所在地點有疊加物：對本敵人造成4點傷害。 強制 – 在本敵人被擊敗時：將其翻面並結算另一面的文本。

cards.name: Memory of an Unrequited Love
cards.text: Alert. Prey - Investigator with Dr. Amy Kensler. [reaction] After you discover 1 or more clues at this enemy's location: Deal that much damage to this enemy. Forced - When this enemy is defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.
cards.text_cn: 警戒。 獵物 – 擁有艾米·肯斯勒博士的調查員。 [reaction]在你發現本敵人所在地點的1個或更多線索後：對本敵人造成該數量的傷害。 強制 – 在本敵人被擊敗時：將其翻面並結算另一面的文本。

cards.name: Horrifying Shade
cards.text: Aloof. Hunter. While Horrifying Shade is at a location that is cleared of mirages, it loses aloof. Forced - After you discover or take control of 1 or more clues at Horrifying Shade's location: Place an equal amount of doom on Horrifying Shade.
cards.text_cn: 冷漠。獵手。 恐怖陰影位於破除幻景的地點時，其失去冷漠。 強制 – 在你發現或控制恐怖陰影所在地點的至少1個線索後：在恐怖陰影上放置與該線索數量相等的毀滅標記。

cards.name: Evanescent Mist
cards.text: Revelation - Attach Evanescent Mist to the nearest location that is not cleared of mirages. Place 2 clues on attached location. In order to flip attached location over, investigators at attached location must either spend 2 additional clues as a group, or each take 2 damage. Forced - If attached location is cleared of mirages: Discard Evanescent Mist.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 將易散之霧疊加到尚未破除幻景的最近地點。在被疊加的地點上放置2個線索。 要將附屬地點翻面，位於附屬地點的調查員必須共同花費額外2個線索，或者各自受到2點傷害。 強制 – 如果被疊加的地點已破除幻景：丟棄易散之霧。

cards.name: Anamnesis
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Take 2 horror. - Place 1 doom on the current agenda. This effect can cause the current agenda to advance.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 – 你必須(選擇一項)： - 受到2點傷害。 - 在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。本效果能導致當前密謀推進。

cards.name: Professor William Dyer
cards.text:
Partner. Uses (3 secrets).
[fast] Spend 1 secret and exhaust Professor William Dyer: Heal 2 horror from an investigator or another [[Ally]] asset at your location.
cards.text_cn:
夥伴。使用(3秘密)。
[fast]花費1秘密並消耗威廉·戴爾教授：治癒你所在地點的一位調查員或另一個[[盟友]]支援2點恐懼。

cards.name: Danforth
cards.text:
Partner. Uses (5 secrets).
[reaction] After an investigator at your location resolves a Tekeli-li weakness, exhaust Danforth and spend 1 secret: That investigator draws 3 cards. Discard each Tekeli-li weakness drawn by this effect without resolving its effects.
cards.text_cn:
夥伴。使用(5秘密)。
[reaction]在你所在地點的調查員結算忒咳哩-哩弱點後，消耗丹佛斯並花費1秘密：該調查員抽取3張卡牌。丟棄由此效果抽取的所有忒咳哩-哩弱點，不要結算其效果。

cards.name: Eliyah Ashevak
cards.text: Partner. Uses (3 secrets). [fast] During your turn, spend 1 secret and exhaust Eliyah Ashevak: Evade. Attempt to evade with a base [agility] skill of 6. If you succeed, you may move to a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 夥伴。使用(3秘密)。 [fast]在你回合期間，花費1秘密並消耗伊里亞·阿什瓦克：躲避。以基礎[agility]值為6的躲避嘗試。如果你檢定成功，你可以移動到一個連接地點。

cards.name: Dr. Mala Sinha
cards.text:
Partner. Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Dr. Mala Sinha: Heal 2 damage from an investigator or another [[Ally]] asset at your location.
cards.text_cn:
夥伴。使用(3補給)。
[fast]花費1補給並消耗瑪拉·辛哈醫生：治癒你所在地點的一位調查員或另一個[[盟友]]支援2點傷害。

cards.name: Avery Claypool
cards.text:
Partner. Uses (3 supplies).
[reaction] When an investigator at your location reveals a [frost] token during a skill test, exhaust Avery Claypool: Cancel that token. Then, you must either reveal a new chaos token, or spend 1 supply.
cards.text_cn:
夥伴。使用(3補給)。
[reaction]在你所在地點的一位調查員在技能檢定期間抽出了一個[frost]標記時，消耗艾弗里·克萊普爾：取消該標記。然後，你必須抽出一個新的混亂標記，或者花費1補給。

cards.name: James "Cookie" Fredericks
cards.name_cn: 詹姆斯·"曲奇"·弗雷德里克斯
cards.text: Partner. Uses (3 ammo). [fast] During your turn, spend 1 ammo and exhaust James "Cookie" Fredericks: Fight. Fight with a base [combat] skill of 6. If you succeed and the attacked enemy is non-[[Elite]], it cannot attack for the remainder of the round.
cards.text_cn: 夥伴。使用(3子彈)。 [fast] 在你回合期間，花費1子彈並消耗詹姆斯·"曲奇"·弗雷德里克斯：攻擊。以基礎[combat]值為6的攻擊。如果你檢定成功，且被攻擊敵人非[[精英]]，則直到本輪結束其不能攻擊。

cards.name: Dr. Amy Kensler
cards.text: Partner. Uses (3 secrets). [fast] During your turn, spend 1 secret and exhaust Dr. Amy Kensler: Investigate. Investigate with a base [intellect] skill of 6. If you succeed, look at the top card of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. You may discard that card.
cards.text_cn: 夥伴。使用(3秘密)。 [fast]在你回合期間，花費1秘密並消耗艾米·肯斯勒博士：調查。以基礎[intellect]值為6的調查。如果你檢定成功，查看任意一位調查員牌堆頂的1張卡牌或遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。你可以丟棄該卡牌。

cards.name: Roald Ellsworth
cards.text:
Partner. Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] During an investigator's turn, either exhaust Roald Ellsworth or spend 1 supply: Choose a non-weakness treachery in play. Treat that treachery's text box as if it were blank until the end of this turn.
cards.text_cn:
夥伴。使用(3補給)。
[fast]一位調查員的回合期間，消耗羅爾德·埃爾斯沃思或者花費1補給：選擇場上一張非弱點詭計。將該詭計的印刷文字方塊視為如同空白，直到本回合結束。

cards.name: Takada Hiroko
cards.text:
Partner. Uses (9 resources).
[action] Exhaust Takada Hiroko: Gain 1 resource. Move up to 3 resources from Takada Hiroko to your resource pool.
cards.text_cn:
夥伴。使用(9資源)。
[action]消耗高田弘子：獲得1資源。將高田弘子上的最多3資源移動到你的資源池。

cards.name: To the Forbidden Peaks
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the level of your location.
[cultist]: -1. If you fail, after this test ends move to the location directly below you.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, lose control of an [[Expedition]] asset and place it at your location.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, the nearest [[Elder Thing]] enemy moves once toward you. If it is engaged with you, it attacks.
cards.text_cn: 簡單 / 普通 [skull]：–X。X為你所在地點的高度。 [cultist]：–1。如果你檢定失敗，在這次檢定結束後移動到你下方緊挨著的地點。(FAQ, v2.1) [tablet]：–3。如果你檢定失敗，失去你對一個[[探險]]支援的控制，並將其放在你所在地點。 [elder_thing]：–4。如果你檢定失敗，最近的[[古老者]]敵人向你移動一次。如果其與你交戰，其攻擊。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 2 plus the level of your location.
[cultist]: -1. After this test ends move to the location directly below you.
[tablet]: -4. If you fail, lose control of an [[Expedition]] asset and place it at your location.
[elder_thing]: -5. If you fail, the nearest [[Elder Thing]] enemy moves once toward you. If it is engaged with you, it attacks.
cards.back_text_cn: 困難 / 專家 [skull]：–X。X為你所在地點的高度加2。 [cultist]：–1。在這次檢定結束後移動到你下方緊挨著的地點。(FAQ, v2.1) [tablet]：–4。如果你檢定失敗，失去你對一個[[探險]]支援的控制，並將其放在你所在地點。 [elder_thing]：–5。如果你檢定失敗，最近的[[古老者]]敵人向你移動一次。如果其與你交戰，其攻擊。

cards.name: Forbidden Peaks
cards.text: Forced - After you move to a location: Return all of your clues to the token pool.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你移動到一個地點後：將你所有線索放回供應堆。
cards.back_text: Put the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy into play at the highest level location with one or more investigators. Each investigator at that location loses control of all [[Expedition]] assets and places them at their location. Read Scenario Interlude: Tragedy Strikes in the Campaign Guide.
cards.back_text_cn: 將放在一邊的星之恐怖敵人放置入場，位於高度最高的、有調查員的地點。所有位於該地點的調查員各自失去其對所有[[探險]]支援的控制，並將那些支援放在自己所處的地點。 閱讀劇本手冊中的冒險幕間故事：悲劇襲來。

cards.name: Terror Descends
cards.text: Forced - After you move to a location: Return all of your clues to the token pool.
cards.text_cn: 強制 - 在你移動到一個地點後：將你所有線索放回供應堆。
cards.back_text: If one or more investigators have resigned, proceed to (→R1). Otherwise, proceed to (→R2).
cards.back_text_cn: 如果有調查員已經撤退，進入(→結局1)。 否則，進入(→結局2)。

cards.name: Ascend the Mountain
cards.text: [action]: Take control of an [[Expedition]] asset at your location. Objective - Get to the top of the mountain. If each undefeated investigator has resigned, advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]：控制你所在地點的一個[[探險]]支援。 目標 – 到達山頂。如果所有未被擊敗的調查員都撤退了，推進場景。

cards.name: Deep Drifts
cards.text: Forced - After you move to Deep Drifts from a location below it: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Draw each weakness discarded this way.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在你從下方的地點移動到深厚積雪後：丟棄掉你牌堆頂3張卡牌。抽取所有以此方式棄掉的弱點。
cards.back_text: You cannot enter this location unless all of the clues on the location directly below it have been discovered.
cards.back_text_cn: 你不能進入本地點，除非下方緊挨著的地點的所有線索都已被發現。

cards.name: White Bluff
cards.text: Forced - After you move to White Bluff from a location below it: Test [agility] (X). X is 1 plus this location's level. If you fail, lose control of an [[Expedition]] asset and place it at White Bluff.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在你從下方的地點移動到白色斷崖後：檢定[agility](X)。X為本地點的高度加1。如果你檢定失敗，失去你對一個[[探險]]支援的控制，並將其放在白色斷崖。
cards.back_text: You cannot enter this location unless all of the clues on the location directly below it have been discovered.
cards.back_text_cn: 你不能進入本地點，除非下方緊挨著的地點的所有線索都已被發現。

cards.name: Steep Incline
cards.text: Forced - After you move to Steep Incline from a location below it: Take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在你從下方的地點移動到陡峭斜坡後：受到1點傷害。
cards.back_text: You cannot enter this location unless all of the clues on the location directly below it have been discovered.
cards.back_text_cn: 你不能進入本地點，除非下方緊挨著的地點的所有線索都已被發現。

cards.name: Narrow Ridge
cards.text: Forced - After you move to Narrow Ridge from a location below it: Take 1 horror.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在你從下方的地點移動到狹窄山脊後：受到1點恐懼。
cards.back_text: You cannot enter this location unless all of the clues on the location directly below it have been discovered.
cards.back_text_cn: 你不能進入本地點，除非下方緊挨著的地點的所有線索都已被發現。

cards.name: Rocky Ledge
cards.text: Forced - After you move to Rocky Ledge from a location below it: Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在你從下方的地點移動到岩架後：將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的一張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，不要查看內容。
cards.back_text: You cannot enter this location unless all of the clues on the location directly below it have been discovered.
cards.back_text_cn: 你不能進入本地點，除非下方緊挨著的地點的所有線索都已被發現。

cards.name: Snow-Covered Crag
cards.text: Forced - After you move to Snow-Covered Crag from a location below it: Exhaust each asset you control.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在你從下方的地點移動到白雪覆蓋的峭壁後：消耗所有你控制的支援。
cards.back_text: You cannot enter this location unless all of the clues on the location directly below it have been discovered.
cards.back_text_cn: 你不能進入本地點，除非下方緊挨著的地點的所有線索都已被發現。

cards.name: Windswept Path
cards.text: Forced - After Windswept Path is revealed: If it is at level 0, place 1 [per_investigator] clues on it (from the token pool). Forced - After you move to Windswept Path from a location below it: Place 1 clue on it (from the token pool).
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在迎風通路被揭示後：如果其為高度0，在其上放置1[per_investigator]個線索(從供應堆拿取)。 強制 – 在你從下方的地點移動到迎風通路後：在其上放置1個線索(從供應堆拿取)。
cards.back_text: You cannot enter this location unless all of the clues on the location directly below it have been discovered.
cards.back_text_cn: 你不能進入本地點，除非下方緊挨著的地點的所有線索都已被發現。

cards.name: The Summit
cards.text: Clues on The Summit can only be discovered by investigating. Forced - When The Summit is revealed: Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag. [action]: Resign. Add each [[Expedition]] asset you control to the victory display. Return all of your clues to the token pool.
cards.text_cn: 山頂的線索只能通過調查發現。 強制 – 在山頂被揭示時：在混亂袋裡加入1個[frost]標記。 [action]：撤退。將所有你控制的[[探險]]支援加入勝利區。將你所有線索放回供應堆。
cards.back_text: You cannot enter this location unless all of the clues on the location directly below it have been discovered.
cards.back_text_cn: 你不能進入本地點，除非下方緊挨著的地點的所有線索都已被發現。

cards.name: Terror of the Stars
cards.text: Hunter. Massive. Terror of the Stars gets +3 [per_investigator] health. X is the level of your location (to a minimum of 1). Forced - At the end of the round: Move all investigators at Terror of the Stars's location to the location directly below it.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。龐大。 星之恐怖得到+3[per_investigator]生命值。 X為你所在地點的高度(至少為1)。 強制 – 當一輪結束時：將星之恐怖所在地點的所有調查員移動到下方緊挨著的地點。

cards.name: Constricting Elder Thing
cards.text:
Hunter.
X is the level of your location (to a minimum of 1).
While Constricting Elder Thing is engaged with you, you cannot move to locations above your location.
cards.text_cn:
獵手。
X為你所在地點的高度(至少為1)。
拘束型古老者與你交戰時，你不能移動到上方的地點。

cards.name: Snowfall
cards.text: Revelation - Place 2 clues on your location (from the token pool).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 在你所在地點放置2個線索(從供應堆拿取)。

cards.name: Avalanche
cards.text: Revelation - If the level of your location is 1-4, move to the location directly below you. Then test [willpower] (X). X is the level of your location. If you fail, repeat this process. If you did not move by this effect, Avalanche gains surge.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 如果你所在地點的高度為1–4，移動到你下方緊挨著的地點。然後，檢定[willpower](X)。X為你所在地點的高度。如果你檢定失敗，重複本過程。如果你沒有因為本效果移動，雪崩獲得湧動。

cards.name: Hanging on the Edge
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, take 2 damage, lose control of each [[Expedition]] asset you control (placing it at your location), and move to the location directly below you.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 檢定[agility](3)。如果你檢定失敗，受到2點傷害，失去你控制的所有[[探險]]支援的控制(放到你所在地點)，並移動到你下方緊挨著的地點。

cards.name: Hypothermia
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). If the level of your location is 4 or 5, reveal 1 additional chaos token for this skill test. If you fail, either add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag, or take 1 horror for each point you failed by.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 檢定[willpower](3)。如果你所在地點的高度為4或5，本次技能檢定額外抽出1個混亂標記。如果你檢定失敗，在混亂袋裡加入1個[frost]標記，或每低於難度1點就受到1點恐懼。

cards.name: Green Soapstone
cards.text:
Uses (4 charges).
[reaction] When you perform a successful attack, spend 1 charge and exhaust Green Soapstone: Deal +1 damage for that attack.
cards.text_cn:
使用(4充能)。
[reaction]在你執行一次成功的攻擊時，花費1充能並消耗綠皂石：這次攻擊造成+1傷害。

cards.name: Wooden Sledge
cards.text:
[action] Exhaust Wooden Sledge: An investigator at this location searches the top 6 cards of their deck for up to 3 non-weakness [[Item]] or [[Supply]] cards and attaches them facedown to Wooden Sledge. Shuffle their deck.
While Wooden Sledge is under an investigator's control, facedown cards attached to it may be played as if they were in the hand of any investigator at its location.
cards.text_cn:
[action]消耗木製雪撬：位於本地點的一位調查員查找其牌堆頂的6張卡牌，找出最多3張非弱點[[道具]]或[[供給]]卡牌，正面朝下疊加到木製雪撬。混洗其牌堆。
木製雪撬在調查員控制下時，正面朝下疊加在木制雪橇的卡牌，可以被位於其所在地點的任意調查員打出，如同該卡牌在該調查員手中。

cards.name: Dynamite
cards.text:
Uses (2 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Dynamite: Choose either your location or a connecting location. Deal 3 damage to each enemy and investigator at the chosen location.
cards.text_cn:
使用(2補給)。
[action]花費1補給並消耗炸藥：選擇你所在地點或一個連接地點。對所選地點的每個敵人和每位調查員各造成3點傷害。

cards.name: Miasmic Crystal
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[reaction] When an investigator at your location draws a Tekeli-li weakness, spend 1 charge: That investigator cancels the effects of that weakness, places it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck, and draws 1 card.
cards.text_cn:
使用(3充能)。
[reaction]在一位你所在地點的調查員抽取到一張忒咳哩-哩弱點時，花費1充能：該調查員取消該弱點的效果，將其放到忒咳哩-哩牌堆底，並抽取1張卡牌。

cards.name: Mineral Specimen
cards.text: Uses (3 charges). [action] Spend 1 charge: Investigate. Investigate with a base [intellect] skill of 5. Cancel each [frost] token revealed during this test. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at your location.
cards.text_cn: 使用(3充能)。 [action]花費1充能：調查。以基礎值為5的[intellect]調查。取消本次檢定期間揭示的所有[frost]標記。如果你檢定成功，發現你所在地點額外1個線索。

cards.name: Small Radio
cards.text: Uses (3 supplies). You may trigger abilities on assets from the Expedition Team encounter set that are not in play, but whose names are not crossed off in the Campaign Log. Instead of paying that ability's non-[action] costs, exhaust Small Radio and spend 1 supply.
cards.text_cn: 使用(3補給)。 你可以觸發不在場上的探險隊遭遇組的支援上的能力(僅限在劇本日誌中沒有劃掉名字的支援)。不支付該能力的非[action]費用，改為消耗小型收音機並花費1補給。

cards.name: Spare Parts
cards.text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Spare Parts: Add 1 supply to another asset at your location, or choose an investigator at your location to gain 1 resource.
cards.text_cn:
使用(3補給)。
[fast]花費1補給並消耗備用零件：在你所在地點的另一個支援上放置1補給，或者選擇你所在地點的一位調查員獲得1資源。

cards.name: City of the Elder Things
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of keys you control.
[cultist]: -2. If you fail, place a key you control on your location.
[tablet]: -3. If a [frost] token was revealed during this test, you automatically fail, instead.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail, the nearest enemy moves once toward you. If it is engaged with you, it attacks.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：–X。X為你控制的鑰匙的數量。
[cultist]：–2。如果你檢定失敗，將你控制的一個鑰匙放到你所在地點。
[tablet]：–3。如果本次檢定期間抽出了[frost]標記，改為你自動失敗。
[elder_thing]：–4。如果你檢定失敗，最近的敵人向你移動一次。如果其與你交戰，其攻擊。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 2 plus the number of keys you control.
[cultist]: -2. Place a key you control on your location.
[tablet]: -4. If a [frost] token was revealed during this test, take 1 damage and you automatically fail, instead.
[elder_thing]: -5. If you fail, the nearest enemy moves once toward you. If it is engaged with you, it attacks.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：–X。X為你控制的鑰匙的數量加2。
[cultist]：–2。將你控制的一個鑰匙放到你所在地點。
[tablet]：–4。如果本次檢定期間抽出了[frost]標記，改為你受到1點傷害且自動失敗。
[elder_thing]：–5。如果你檢定失敗，最近的敵人向你移動一次。如果其與你交戰，其攻擊。

cards.name: Lurking Horrors
cards.text:
[fast] During your turn, spend 1 clue: Look at the revealed side of a City Landscape in your column or row. (Limit once per round.)
[fast] During your turn, spend 3 clues: Move to any location in your column or row. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn:
[fast]在你回合期間，花費1個線索：查看你所在行或列的一個城市景觀的已揭示面。(每輪限制一次。)
[fast]在你回合期間，花費3個線索：移動到你所在行或列的任意地點。(每輪限制一次。)
cards.back_text: Read Scenario Interlude: Gaze into Madness in the Campaign Log.
cards.back_text_cn: 閱讀劇本手冊中的冒險幕間故事：凝視瘋狂。

cards.name: Doom from Below
cards.text:
[fast] During your turn, spend 1 clue: Look at the revealed side of a City Landscape in your column or row. (Limit once per round.)
[fast] During your turn, spend 3 clues: Move to any location in your column or row. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn:
[fast]在你回合期間，花費1個線索：查看你所在行或列的一個城市景觀的已揭示面。(每輪限制一次。)
[fast]在你回合期間，花費3個線索：移動到你所在行或列的任意地點。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Sprawling City (v. I)
cards.text: [action] Spend two [elder_thing] keys: Remember that the team "studied the history of the Elder Things." [action] Spend two [tablet] keys: Remember that the team "discerned the origin of the Shoggoths." Objective - If the team has "studied the history of the Elder Things" and "discerned the origin of the Shoggoths," advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費2個[elder_thing]鑰匙：請記住團隊"研究了古老者的歷史"。 [action]花費2個[tablet]鑰匙：請記住團隊"瞭解了修格斯的起源"。 目標 – 如果團隊"研究了古老者的歷史"且"瞭解了修格斯的起源"，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Shoggoths encounter set and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. You know the route into the undercity. Reveal the Hidden Tunnel. Put the set-aside Terror of the Stars enemy into play at the Hidden Tunnel, exhausted.
cards.back_text_cn:
將放在一邊的修格斯遭遇組和遭遇棄牌堆混洗入遭遇牌堆。
你知道去地下城市的通路。揭示隱秘隧道。
將放在一邊的星之恐怖敵人放置入場，位於隱秘隧道，處於消耗狀態。

cards.name: Sprawling City (v. II)
cards.text: [action] Spend two [elder_thing] keys: Remember that the team "studied the history of the Elder Things." [action] Spend two [cultist] keys: Remember that the team "discovered a hidden power." Objective - If the team has "studied the history of the Elder Things" and "discovered a hidden power," advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費2個[elder_thing]鑰匙：請記住團隊"研究了古老者的歷史"。 [action]花費2個[cultist]鑰匙：請記住團隊"發現了隱藏的力量"。 目標 – 如果團隊"研究了古老者的歷史"且"發現了隱藏的力量"，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Creatures in the Ice encounter set and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. You know the route into the undercity. Reveal the Hidden Tunnel. Add 1 [frost] token to the chaos bag.
cards.back_text_cn:
將放在一邊的冰中生物遭遇組和遭遇棄牌堆混洗入遭遇牌堆。
你知道去地下城市的通路。揭示隱秘隧道。在混亂袋裡加入1個[frost]標記。

cards.name: Sprawling City (v. III)
cards.text: [action] Spend two [tablet] keys: Remember that the team "discerned the origin of the Shoggoths." [action] Spend two [cultist] keys: Remember that the team "discovered a hidden power." Objective - If the team has "discerned the origin of the Shoggoths" and "discovered a hidden power," advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費2個[tablet]鑰匙：請記住團隊"瞭解了修格斯的起源"。 [action]花費2個[cultist]鑰匙：請記住團隊"發現了隱藏的力量"。 目標 – 如果團隊"瞭解了修格斯的起源"且"發現了隱藏的力量"，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Shuffle the set-aside Shoggoths encounter set and the encounter discard pile into the encounter deck. You know the route into the undercity. Reveal the Hidden Tunnel. In player order, each investigator draws 1 card from the top of the encounter deck.
cards.back_text_cn:
將放在一邊的修格斯遭遇組和遭遇棄牌堆混洗入遭遇牌堆。
你知道去地下城市的通路。揭示隱秘隧道。
按玩家順序，每位調查員抽取遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。

cards.name: Pursuit of the Unknown (v. I)
cards.text: [action] Spend two [cultist] keys: Each investigator may heal 1 damage, 1 horror, and 1 trauma. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at the Hidden Tunnel and it has no clues, advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費2個[cultist]鑰匙：每位調查員可以治癒1點傷害、1點恐懼和1點創傷。 目標 – 如果每位沒有被擊敗的調查員都在隱秘隧道，且隱秘隧道沒有線索，推進場景。

cards.name: Pursuit of the Unknown (v. II)
cards.text: [action] Spend two [tablet] keys: Each investigator searches their deck for each Tekeli-li weakness, shuffles each of them into the Tekeli-li deck, then shuffles their deck. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at the Hidden Tunnel and it has no clues, advance.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費2個[tablet]鑰匙：每位調查員查找各自牌組，找出所有忒咳哩-哩弱點，將這些弱點混洗入忒咳哩-哩牌堆，然後混洗各自牌庫。 目標 – 如果每位沒有被擊敗的調查員都在隱秘隧道，且隱秘隧道沒有線索，推進場景。

cards.name: Pursuit of the Unknown (v. III)
cards.text: Forced - When a [[Shoggoth]] or [[Elite]] enemy enters a location: Defeat each [[Elder Thing]] enemy at that location. [action] Spend two [elder_thing] keys: Remove each [elder_thing] token from the chaos bag. Objective - If each undefeated investigator is at the Hidden Tunnel and it has no clues, advance.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在一個[[修格斯]]或[[精英]]敵人進入一個地點時：擊敗該地點的所有[[古老者]]敵人。 [action]花費2個[elder_thing]鑰匙：從混亂袋裡移除所有[elder_thing]標記。 目標 – 如果每位沒有被擊敗的調查員都在隱秘隧道，且隱秘隧道沒有線索，推進場景。

cards.name: Hidden Tunnel
cards.text:
Clues on Hidden Tunnel cannot be discovered or moved to other locations.
[action]: Test a skill of your choice (4). You may spend a [skull] key to get +5 skill value for this test. If you succeed, return 1 clue on Hidden Tunnel to the token pool (2 clues instead if you spent a [skull] key).
cards.text_cn:
隱密隧道的線索不能被發現或移動到其他地點。
[action]：任選一項技能檢定(4)。你可以花費一個[skull]鑰匙來使你本次檢定得到技能值+5。如果你檢定成功，將隱密隧道上的1個線索返回到供應堆(如果你花費了一個[skull]鑰匙，改為2個線索)。
cards.back_text: The passageway into the undercity is hidden. You cannot enter the Hidden Tunnel.
cards.back_text_cn: 進入地下城市的通道被隱藏了。你不能進入隱密隧道。

cards.name: Ancient Planetarium
cards.text: [action] Spend two "0" keys: Add one of the spent "0" keys to the chaos bag (as a chaos token) for the remainder of the campaign. Record in the Campaign Log the team photographed the astronomical charts.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費2個"0"鑰匙：在混亂袋裡加入花費的其中一個"0"鑰匙(作為一個混亂標記)，直到劇本結束。在劇本日誌中記錄團隊拍攝了天文圖的照片。

cards.name: Stone Bridge
cards.text:
[action]: Test [combat] (4) or [agility] (4). If you succeed, discover 1 clue from Stone Bridge.
[action]: Move to another Stone Bridge location.
cards.text_cn:
[action]：檢定[combat](4)或[agility](4)。如果你檢定成功，發現石橋的1個線索。
[action]：移動到另一個石橋地點。

cards.name: Cylindrical Tower
cards.text: [action] Spend two "-2" keys: Draw 2 cards, gain 2 resources, and remove 2 [frost] tokens from the chaos bag. Record in the Campaign Log the team studied the mural carvings.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費2個"–2"鑰匙：抽取2張卡牌，獲得2資源，並從混亂袋裡移除2個[frost]標記。在劇本日誌中記錄團隊研究了壁畫雕刻。

cards.name: Labyrinthine Chamber
cards.text: Each time a chaos token is revealed during a skill test at this location, double its modifier if a key matching that chaos token is on this location or under the control of an investigator at this location.
cards.text_cn: 每次本地點的一次技能檢定期間抽出一個混亂標記時，如果本地點上的鑰匙或者本地點一位調查員控制的鑰匙與該混亂標記一致，將該混亂標記的修正值翻倍。

cards.name: Map Room
cards.text: [action] Spend two "-3" keys: Choose 3 locations other than Hidden Tunnel and reveal them. Discover 1 clue from each of these locations. Record in the Campaign Log the team read the map.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費2個"–3"鑰匙：選擇3個隱密隧道以外的地點並將其揭示。(FAQ, v2.1)在這些地點中每個地點各發現1個線索。在劇本日誌中記錄團隊查看了地圖。

cards.name: Roofless Rampart
cards.text: [action] Spend two "-1" keys: Either remove 1 doom from the agenda, or choose and discard from play 1 non-[[Elite]] enemy or treachery. Record in the Campaign Log the team discovered an ancient vault.
cards.text_cn: [action]花費2個"–1"鑰匙：移除密謀上的1個毀滅標記，或者選擇並棄掉場上1個非[[精英]]敵人或詭計。在劇本日誌中記錄團隊發現了一個古代墓穴。

cards.name: Ruinous Streets
cards.text: Forced - After you reveal 1 or more [frost] tokens during a skill test at Ruinous Streets: Take 1 damage. [reaction] After you discover the last clue from Ruinous Streets: Discover 1 clue on a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在你在破敗街道的技能檢定期間抽出1個或更多[frost]混亂標記後：受到1點傷害。 [reaction]在你發現破敗街道上最後的線索後：發現一個連接地點的1個線索。

cards.name: Cyclopean Spires
cards.text: [action]: Move 1 key on another location in this row to Cyclopean Spires. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：將本列另一個地點的1個鑰匙移動到巨大尖頂。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次)。

cards.name: Submerged Passageway
cards.text: [action]: Move 1 clue from this location to an unrevealed location in this column or row.
cards.text_cn: [action]：將本地點上的1個線索移動到本行或本列的一個未揭示的地點。

cards.name: Temple of the Elder Things
cards.text: Forced - After you reveal 1 or more [frost] tokens during a skill test at this location: Take 1 horror. [action] If there are no clues on Temple of the Elder Things: Choose 2 locations with keys on them. Swap each key on those locations. (Group limit once per game.)
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在你在本地點的技能檢定期間揭示1個或更多[frost]混亂標記後：受到1點恐懼。 [action]如果古老者之廟沒有線索：選擇2個有鑰匙的地點。交換這些地點的所有鑰匙。(團隊每場遊戲限制一次)。

cards.name: Terror of the Stars
cards.text:
Hunter. Massive.
Terror of the Stars gets +3 [per_investigator] health.
While Terror of the Stars is ready, investigators at its location cannot spend or take control of keys.
cards.text_cn:
獵手。龐大。
星之恐怖得到+3[per_investigator]生命值。
星之恐怖處於準備狀態時，位於其所在地點的調查員不能花費或控制鑰匙。

cards.name: Benign Elder Thing
cards.text: Spawn - Any empty location. Benign Elder Thing enters play with 1 doom on it. Forced - When Benign Elder Thing is defeated: Place 1 doom on the agenda. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, remove Benign Elder Thing from the game.
cards.text_cn: 生成 – 任意無人地點。 和藹的古老者入場時，帶有一個毀滅標記。 強制 – 在和藹的古老者被擊敗時：在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。 [action]：談判。檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定成功，將和藹的古老者從遊戲中移除。

cards.name: Reawakened Elder Thing
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - When this enemy engages you: Place a key you control on it. When it leaves play, place that key on its location. Forced - When an investigator at this enemy's location takes control of a key: This enemy readies, engages, and attacks them.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 – 在本敵人與你交戰時：將你控制的一個鑰匙放在本敵人上。在本敵人離場時，將該鑰匙放在本敵人所在地點。 強制 – 在本敵人所在地點的一位調查員控制一個鑰匙時：本敵人準備、與該調查員交戰，並攻擊該調查員。

cards.name: Dawning of the Truth
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). Increase the difficulty of this test by 1 for each key on your location or under your control. If you fail, take 2 horror (3 horror instead if you fail by 3 or more).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 檢定[willpower](2)。本次檢定難度值增加你所在地點和你控制的鑰匙數之和。如果你檢定失敗，受到2點恐懼(如果你檢定失敗且低於難度至少3點，改為3點恐懼)。

cards.name: Crumbling Ruins
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). During this test, if you reveal a chaos token that matches a key on your location or under the control of an investigator at your location, you automatically fail. For each point you fail by, take 1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 檢定[agility](3)。本次檢定期間，如果你抽出了一個與你所在地點的鑰匙或者你所在地點一位調查員控制的鑰匙一致的混亂標記，你自動失敗。你檢定失敗且每低於難度1點，受到1點傷害。

cards.name: Frostbitten
cards.text: Revelation - Put Frostbitten into play in your threat area. Frostbitten can be healed as if it were a single point of damage on you (if it is healed, discard it). Forced - When you reveal a [frost] token during a skill test: You must either take 1 damage or you automatically fail this test. (Limit once per test.)
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將凍傷放置入場，放在你的威脅區域。 凍傷可被治癒，如同是你身上的1點傷害(如果其被治癒，將其丟棄)。 強制 - 在你在技能檢定期間抽出[frost]混亂標記時：你必須受到1點傷害或本次檢定自動失敗。(每次檢定限制一次。)

cards.name: Possessed
cards.text: Revelation - Put Possessed into play in your threat area. Possessed can be healed as if it were a single point of horror on you (if it is healed, discard it). Forced - When you reveal a [frost] token during a skill test: You must either take 1 horror or you automatically fail this test. (Limit once per test.)
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將附身放置入場，放在你的威脅區域。 附身可被治癒，如同是你身上的1點恐懼(如果其被治癒，將其丟棄)。 強制 - 在你在技能檢定期間抽出[frost]混亂標記時：你必須受到1點恐懼或本次檢定自動失敗。(每次檢定限制一次。)

cards.name: The Heart of Madness
cards.text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if there is an [[Ancient One]] enemy at your location).
[cultist]: -1. If there is a seal at your location, or if your location is a Mist-Pylon, treat this token as a [frost] token, instead.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, draw the top card of the Tekeli-li deck.
[elder_thing]: -4. If you fail by 3 or more, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This can cause the current agenda to advance.
cards.text_cn:
簡單 / 普通
[skull]：–1(如果你所在地點有[[古神]]敵人，改為–3)。
[cultist]：–1。如果你所在地點有封印，或者你所在地點是迷霧高塔，改為將本標記視為[frost]標記。
[tablet]：–3。如果你檢定失敗，抽取忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌。
[elder_thing]：–4。如果你檢定失敗且低於難度至少3點，在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。本效果能導致當前密謀推進。
cards.back_text:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if there is an [[Ancient One]] enemy at your location).
[cultist]: -1. If there is a seal at your location, or if your location is a Mist-Pylon, treat this token as a [frost] token in addition to its modifier.
[tablet]: -3. Draw the top card of the Tekeli-li deck.
[elder_thing]: -5. If you fail by 3 or more, place 1 doom on the current agenda. This can cause the current agenda to advance.
cards.back_text_cn:
困難 / 專家
[skull]：–2(如果你所在地點有[[古神]]敵人，改為–4)。
[cultist]：–1。如果你所在地點有封印，或者你所在地點是迷霧高塔，除其修正值外，還將本標記視為[frost]標記。
[tablet]：–3。抽取忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌。
[elder_thing]：–5。如果你檢定失敗且低於難度至少3點，在當前密謀上放置1個毀滅標記。本效果能導致當前密謀推進。

cards.name: The Gate of Y'quaa
cards.text: [action]: Place an activated seal you control on The Gate of Y'quaa. [action]: Resign. You retreat, hoping you've done enough to seal away whatever lies beyond the gate. (If you control 1 or more seals, you retain control of them.)
cards.text_cn: [action]：將你控制的一個啟動的封印放在伊誇之門。 [action]：撤退。你撤退了，希望你已經做了足夠的工作，能夠把大門彼端的東西封印起來(如果你控制著1個或更多封印，你保留它們的控制權)。
cards.back_text: A wall of churning miasma blocks the ancient gateway. Investigators and enemies cannot enter The Gate of Y'quaa. The Gate of Y'quaa cannot have attachments.
cards.back_text_cn: 一堵翻滾的瘴氣之牆擋住了古老的大門，調查員和敵人不能進入伊誇之門。伊誇之門不能擁有疊加物。

cards.name: Geothermal Vent
cards.text: [action] If you control the [seal_a] seal: Test [combat] (3). If you succeed, investigators at Geothermal Vent spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to activate the [seal_a] seal. Then, remove 1 [frost] token from the chaos bag.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你控制[seal_a]封印：檢定[combat](3)。如果你檢定成功，位於地暖口的調查員可以共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索，來啟動[seal_a]封印。然後，從混亂袋裡移除1個[frost]標記。

cards.name: Forsaken Temple
cards.text: [action] If you control the [seal_c] seal: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, investigators at Forsaken Temple spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to activate the [seal_c] seal. Then, look at the revealed side of each unrevealed location on the same spoke as Forsaken Temple.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你控制[seal_c]封印：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定成功，位於被遺忘的神廟的調查員可以共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索，來啟動[seal_c]封印。然後，查看與被遺忘的神廟在同一輻條上的，所有未揭示地點的已揭示面。

cards.name: Library of Kós
cards.text: [action] If you control the [seal_b] seal: Test [intellect] (3). If you succeed, investigators at Library of Kós spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to activate the [seal_b] seal. Then, look at the revealed side of each unrevealed location on the same ring as Library of Kós.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你控制[seal_b]封印：檢定[intellect](3)。如果你檢定成功，位於寇斯圖書館的調查員可以共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索，來啟動[seal_b]封印。然後，查看與寇斯圖書館在同一環形上的，所有未揭示地點的已揭示面。

cards.name: Protoplasmic Pool
cards.text: [action] If you control the [seal_d] seal: Test [agility] (3). If you succeed, investigators at Protoplasmic Pool spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to activate the [seal_d] seal. Then, deal 2 damage to each enemy in play.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你控制[seal_d]封印：檢定[agility](3)。如果你檢定成功，位於原生質池的調查員可以共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索，來啟動[seal_d]封印。然後，對場上所有敵人各造成2點傷害。

cards.name: Hall of the Sunless Sea
cards.text: [action] If you control the [seal_e] seal, investigators at Hall of the Sunless Sea spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and discard 2 [per_investigator] cards from their hands, as a group: Activate the [seal_e] seal.
cards.text_cn: [action]如果你控制[seal_e]封印，位於無光之海大廳的調查員可以共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索並丟棄2[per_investigator]張手牌：啟動[seal_e]封印。

cards.name: Subnautical Sprawl
cards.text: Treat the modifier of the first [frost] token revealed during each skill test at Subnautical Sprawl as -3 instead of -1. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: 在水下擴張區的每次技能檢定期間，將第一個抽出的[frost]標記視為–3，而不是–1。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Vaulted Corridor
cards.text: [fast]: Choose another Vaulted Corridor and test [agility] (X). X is the number of locations away that Vaulted Corridor is from this one. If you succeed, move there. (Limit once per round.)
cards.text_cn: [fast]：選擇另一個拱形走廊並檢定[agility](X)。X為本地點到該拱形走廊的地點數量。如果你檢定成功，移動到該地點。(每輪限制一次。)

cards.name: Primeval Terror
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each location away from The Gate of Y'quaa you are. If you fail, take 2 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 檢定[willpower](2)。你所在地點到伊誇之門每有一個地點，本次檢定得到+1難度。如果你檢定失敗，受到2點恐懼。

cards.name: Roots of the Earth
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (2). This test gets +1 difficulty for each location away from The Gate of Y'quaa you are. If you fail, take 2 damage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 檢定[agility](2)。你所在地點到伊誇之門每有一個地點，本次檢定得到+1難度。如果你檢定失敗，受到2點傷害。

cards.name: The Beating Heart
cards.text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 如果在同一地點有至少二個由調查員控制的啟動的封印：儲存在封印內的潛在能量聚合在一起，隨後的連鎖反應引發靜電爆炸，摧毀了地球上的所有生命。(→結局3)
cards.back_text: Read Scenario Interlude: The Final Straw in the Campaign Guide.
cards.back_text_cn: 閱讀劇本手冊中的冒險幕間故事：最後一根稻草。

cards.name: The Miasma Beckons
cards.text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 如果在同一地點有至少二個由調查員控制的啟動的封印：儲存在封印內的潛在能量聚合在一起，隨後的連鎖反應引發靜電爆炸，摧毀了地球上的所有生命。(→結局3)
cards.back_text:
Check the seals controlled by each investigator (if a seal is not controlled by an investigator, skip it).
The investigator who controls the [seal_a] seal takes 1 damage (2 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_b] seal discards 2 random cards from their hand (4 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_c] seal takes 1 horror (2 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_d] seal loses 1 action (2 instead if the seal is activated).
The investigator who controls the [seal_e] seal loses 3 resources (6 instead if the seal is activated).
cards.back_text_cn:
檢查由每位調查員控制的封印(如果有封印不是由調查員控制的，跳過它)。
控制[seal_a]封印的調查員受到1點傷害(如果封印是啟動的，改為2點)。
控制[seal_b]封印的調查員隨機丟棄2張手牌(如果封印是啟動的，改為4張)。
控制[seal_c]封印的調查員受到1點恐懼(如果封印是啟動的，改為2點)。
控制[seal_d]封印的調查員失去1個行動(如果封印是啟動的，改為2個)。
控制[seal_e]封印的調查員失去3資源(如果封印是啟動的，改為6資源)。

cards.name: Call of Madness
cards.text: Forced - If two or more activated seals are controlled by investigators at the same location: The latent energy stored within the seals fuses together, and the ensuing chain reaction sets off an electrostatic detonation that destroys all life on Earth. (→R3)
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 如果在同一地點有至少二個由調查員控制的啟動的封印：儲存在封印內的潛在能量聚合在一起，隨後的連鎖反應引發靜電爆炸，摧毀了地球上的所有生命。(→結局3)
cards.back_text: Each remaining investigator is defeated and must either suffer 1 mental trauma or shuffle the top 3 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck.
cards.back_text_cn: 剩餘的每位調查員被擊敗，且必須受到1點精神創傷，或者將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的3張卡牌混洗入自己的牌堆。

cards.name: Dormancy
cards.text: Objective - If an activated seal is placed on The Gate of Y'quaa, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 – 如果一個啟動的封印被放到伊誇之門上，推進場景。
cards.back_text: Check which seal was just placed (do not remove it). If it was the [seal_a] seal, the investigator who placed it heals 1 damage. If it was the [seal_b] seal, the investigator who placed it draws 2 cards. If it was the [seal_c] seal, the investigator who placed it heals 1 horror. If it was the [seal_d] seal, the investigator who placed it may take an additional action this turn. If it was the [seal_e] seal, the investigator who placed it gains 3 resources.
cards.back_text_cn: 檢查剛剛放置的是哪個封印(不要移除它)。 如果是[seal_a]封印，放置該封印的調查員治癒1點傷害。 如果是[seal_b]封印，放置該封印的調查員抽取2張卡牌。 如果是[seal_c]封印，放置該封印的調查員治癒1點恐懼。 如果是[seal_d]封印，放置該封印的調查員本回合可以進行額外一個行動。 如果是[seal_e]封印，放置該封印的調查員獲得3資源。

cards.name: The Great Seal
cards.text: Objective - Place as many activated seals as you can on The Gate of Y'quaa before whatever is inside escapes. If all five seals have been placed, advance.
cards.text_cn: 目標 – 在裡面的東西逃離前，在伊誇之門上放置盡可能多的啟動的封印。如果放置了所有五個封印，推進場景。

cards.name: Glacial Grotto
cards.text: Forced - After Glacial Grotto is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_a] seal on it. [action]: Test [combat] (2) to shatter the ice. If you succeed, investigators at Glacial Grotto may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, for you to take control of the seal on it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在冰川岩洞被揭示後：將休眠的[seal_a]封印放在它上面。 [action]：檢定[combat](2)來打碎冰塊。如果你檢定成功，位於冰川岩洞的調查員可以共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索，來使你控制其上的封印。

cards.name: Sculptured Crypt
cards.text: Forced - After Sculptured Crypt is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_b] seal on it. [action]: Test [intellect] (2) to decipher the alien script. If you succeed, investigators at Sculptured Crypt may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, for you to take control of the seal on it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在雕畫密室被揭示後：將休眠的[seal_b]封印放在它上面。 [action]：檢定[intellect](2)來破譯異星文字。如果你檢定成功，位於雕畫密室的調查員可以共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索，來使你控制其上的封印。

cards.name: Undercity Altar
cards.text: Forced - After Undercity Altar is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_c] seal on it. [action]: Test [willpower] (2) to break the ancient ward. If you succeed, investigators at Undercity Altar may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, for you to take control of the seal on it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在地城祭壇被揭示後：將休眠的[seal_c]封印放在它上面。 [action]：檢定[willpower](2)來打破古代結界。如果你檢定成功，位於地城祭壇的調查員可以共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索，來使你控制其上的封印。

cards.name: Ichor-Laden Tunnels
cards.text: Forced - After Ichor-Laden Tunnels is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_d] seal on it. [action]: Test [agility] (2) to traverse the ichor. If you succeed, investigators at Ichor-Laden Tunnels may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, for you to take control of the seal on it.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在膿水隧道被揭示後：將休眠的[seal_d]封印放在它上面。 [action]：檢定[agility](2)來穿過膿水。如果你檢定成功，位於膿水隧道的調查員可以共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索，來使你控制其上的封印。

cards.name: Limestone Caverns
cards.text: Forced - After Limestone Caverns is revealed: Place the dormant [seal_e] seal on it. [action] Investigators at Limestone Caverns spend 1 [per_investigator] clues and 3 [per_investigator] resources, as a group: Take control of the seal on Limestone Caverns.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在灰岩洞穴被揭示後：將休眠的[seal_e]封印放在它上面。 [action]位於灰岩洞穴的調查員共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索和3[per_investigator]資源：控制灰岩洞穴上的封印。

cards.name: Protoplasmic Mass
cards.text: Hunter. Spawn - Location farthest from you on the outer ring. Prey - Nearest investigator with a seal only. Forced - When the enemy phase ends, if an investigator controls an activated seal: Protoplasmic Mass readies and resolves the enemy phase again (it resolves its hunter keyword and attacks a second time). (Limit once per phase.)
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 生成 – 最外的環形上距離你最遠的地點。 獵物 – 僅對擁有封印的最近調查員。 強制 – 在敵軍階段結束時，如果一位調查員控制著啓動的封印：原生質團準備並再次結算敵軍階段(其結算其獵手關鍵詞並再次攻擊)。(FAQ, v2.1)

cards.name: Electrostatic Discharge
cards.text: Surge. Revelation - Each investigator at the same location as a seal takes 1 horror, and 1 damage if that seal is activated
cards.text_cn: 湧動。 顯現 – 每位與一個封印在同一地點的調查員受到1點恐懼，如果該封印是啟動的，再受到1點傷害。

cards.name: The Seal Weakens
cards.back_text:
Spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness enemy at the Mist-Pylon nearest to an investigator.
Check the Campaign Log. If the truth of the mirage eludes you:
You stare, dumbstruck, at the hideous phantasmagoria. The air shimmers with a dreamlike quality about its damnable form, an endless weave of intermingled nightmare and memory. The very sight of it drives you to your knees. It is the final truth. Reality was the mirage.
Each investigator searches their deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and draws them one at a time in a random order, without placing them on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. After resolving all of them, shuffle each of them back into their bearer's deck.
cards.back_text_cn:
在離一位調查員最近的迷霧高塔生成1張放在一邊的無名瘋狂敵人。
檢查劇本日誌。如果你尚未明瞭幻景的真相：
你呆呆地望著這千變萬化的可怕幻景。空氣中閃爍著夢幻般的光芒，噩夢和記憶在無盡地交織著。一看到它你就不由自主跪了下來。這是終極真相。現實曾是幻景。
每位調查員查找各自牌組，找出其中所有忒咳哩-哩，並依次隨機抽取這些卡牌，不要將它們放在忒咳哩-哩牌堆底。在結算完所有這些卡牌後，將它們各自混洗入其承受者的牌堆。

cards.name: That Which Has No Name
cards.text: Forced - When 1 or more doom would be put into play, if there are any copies of The Nameless Madness still set aside: Instead, spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness at the location nearest to an investigator without a copy of that enemy that is connected to a location with a copy of that enemy. Objective - At the end of the round, if all 15 copies of The Nameless Madness are in play and not every Mist-Pylon is collapsed, advance this agenda.
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 在至少1個毀滅標記將要被放置入場時，如果仍然有放在一邊的無名瘋狂：改為在一個沒有無名瘋狂敵人，但連接地點有該敵人的，離調查員最近的地點生成1張無名瘋狂。 目標 –當一輪結束時，如果所有15張無名瘋狂都在場上，且並非所有迷霧高塔都被摧毀，推進本密謀。
cards.back_text:
For each Mist-Pylon that is collapsed, set 3 copies of The Nameless Madness aside.
Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Remove each location except The Gate of Y'quaa from the game. Investigators and copies of The Nameless Madness are not defeated by this effect. All other cards at these locations are discarded.
Put the 4 set-aside Titanic Ramp locations into play in a straight line to the right of The Gate of Y'quaa. Put the set-aside Hidden Tunnel location into play to the right of the rightmost Titanic Ramp. Place each investigator and each remaining copy of The Nameless Madness in play at the leftmost Titanic Ramp.
Remove the act deck from the game and advance to the set-aside The Final Mirage. It is both the current act and the current agenda.
cards.back_text_cn:
每有一個被摧毀的迷霧高塔，將3張無名瘋狂放在一邊。
每位調查員失去其所有線索。
將除了伊誇之門外的所有地點從遊戲中移除。調查員和無名瘋狂不會被本效果擊敗。丟棄這些地點上的所有其他卡牌。
將4張放在一邊的巨大坡道地點放置入場，在伊誇之門右邊排成一條直線。將放在一邊的隱密隧道地點放置入場，位於最右邊的巨大坡道右邊。將所有調查員和剩餘的所有無名瘋狂放置入場，位於最左邊的巨大坡道。
將場景牌堆從遊戲中移除，並推進至放在一邊的最終幻景。它既是當前場景也是當前密謀。

cards.name: Collapse the Pylons
cards.text: Each revealed Mist-Pylon can be attacked as if it were an enemy. Its fight value is equal to its shroud value and its health is equal to its clue value. While it has no health remaining, it is collapsed (it remains in play). [reaction] When you discover 1 or more clues at a Mist-Pylon, spend those clues: Deal that much damage to that Mist-Pylon. Objective - At the end of the round, if each Mist-Pylon is collapsed, advance this act.
cards.text_cn: 每個已揭示的迷霧高塔可以被攻擊，如同它是敵人。它的攻擊值等於它的隱藏值，它的生命值等於它的線索值。它沒有剩餘生命值時，它被摧毀(仍然保持在場上)。 [reaction]在你發現迷霧高塔上的1個或更多線索時，花費那些線索：對該迷霧高塔造成該數量的傷害。 目標 – 當一輪結束時，如果所有迷霧高塔都被摧毀，推進本場景。
cards.back_text:
