Each investigator loses all of their clues.
Remove each location except The Gate of Y'quaa from the game. Investigators and copies of The Nameless Madness are not defeated by this effect. All other cards at those locations are discarded.
Put the 4 set-aside Titanic Ramp locations into play in a straight line to the right of The Gate of Y'quaa. Put the set-aside Hidden Tunnel location into play to the right of the rightmost Titanic Ramp. Place each investigator and each remaining copy of The Nameless Madness in play at the leftmost Titanic Ramp.
Remove the agenda deck from the game and advance to the set-aside The Final Mirage. It is both the current act and the current agenda.

將密謀牌堆從遊戲中移除，並推進至放在一邊的最終幻景。它既是當前場景也是當前密謀。

cards.text: [fast] If you control the [seal_a] seal, and it is activated: You unleash the seal's power. Place the [seal_a] seal on this Mist-Pylon. For the remainder of the game, each time you deal damage to a Mist-Pylon, deal 1 additional damage.
cards.text_cn: [fast]如果你控制[seal_a]封印，且其是啟動的：你釋放了封印的力量。將[seal_a]封印放在本迷霧高塔上。直到本場遊戲結束，每當你對一個迷霧高塔造成傷害，額外造成1點傷害。
cards.back_text: As an additional cost for you to enter Mist-Pylon, investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group.
cards.back_text_cn: 作為你進入迷霧高塔的額外費用，你所在地點的調查員必須共同花費1[per_investigator]個線索。

cards.name: The Nameless Madness
cards.text: Alert. Massive. Retaliate. The Nameless Madness cannot take damage. Forced - After you successfully evade or attack The Nameless Madness: For each point you succeeded by, exhaust the nearest ready copy of The Nameless Madness.
cards.text_cn: 警戒。龐大。反擊。 無名瘋狂不能受到傷害。 強制 – 在你成功躲避或攻擊無名瘋狂後：你每超過難度1點，消耗最近的一個準備狀態的無名瘋狂。

cards.name: Unsealed Phantasm
cards.text: Spawn - The nearest Mist-Pylon that is not collapsed (or your location, if there are none in play). While Unsealed Phantasm is ready and at a Mist-Pylon, damage cannot be dealt to that Mist-Pylon. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Unsealed Phantasm is ready: Move it once toward the Mist-Pylon nearest to it that is not collapsed.
cards.text_cn: 生成 – 最近的未被摧毀的迷霧高塔(如場上沒有，則為你所在地點)。未封印的幻影處於準備狀態且位於迷霧高塔時，不能對該迷霧高塔造成傷害。 強制 – 當敵軍階段結束時，如果未封印的幻影處於準備狀態：將其朝最近的未被摧毀的迷霧高塔移動一次。

cards.name: The Final Mirage
cards.text: The Nameless Madness gains hunter. Forced - When 1 or more doom would be put into play: Instead, spawn 1 set-aside copy of The Nameless Madness at the leftmost investigator's location. Objective - Run.
cards.text_cn: 無名瘋狂獲得獵手。 強制 – 在至少1個毀滅標記將要被放置入場時：改為在最左邊的調查員所在地點生成一張放在一邊的無名瘋狂敵人。 目標 – 跑。
cards.back_text: Check the Campaign Log. - If all 5 Mist-Pylons were collapsed and Dr. Kensler has a plan, proceed to (→R1). - If all 5 Mist-Pylons were collapsed and the truth of the mirage eludes you, proceed to (→R2). - Otherwise, proceed to (→R3).
cards.back_text_cn: 檢查劇本日誌。 - 如果所有5個迷霧高塔都被摧毀，且肯斯勒博士有一個計畫，進入(→結局1)。 - 如果所有5個迷霧高塔都被摧毀，且且你尚未明瞭幻景的真相，進入(→結局2)。 - 否則，進入(→結局3)。

cards.back_text: Hidden Tunnel is connected to the location to its left.

cards.name: Primordial Evil
cards.text: Hunter. Retaliate. Forced - When you deal any amount of damage to Primordial Evil: Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (if you cannot, Primordial Evil attacks you).
cards.text_cn: 獵手。反擊。 強制 – 在你對原初惡魔造成任意數量的傷害時：將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，不要查看內容(如果你不能這麼做，原初惡魔攻擊你)。

cards.name: The Madness Within
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). For each point you fail by, shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it (for each card you cannot shuffle, take 1 horror).
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 檢定[willpower](4)。你檢定失敗且每低於難度1點，將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，不要查看內容(每有1張卡牌不能混洗入你的牌堆，受到1點恐懼)。

cards.name: Manifestation of Madness
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - When Manifestation of Madness attacks you: Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at them (for each card you cannot shuffle, Manifestation of Madness deals +1 damage and +1 horror for this attack).
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 – 在實體瘋狂攻擊你時：將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的2張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，不要查看內容(每有1張卡牌不能混洗入你的牌堆，實體瘋狂該次攻擊造成+1點傷害和+1點恐懼)。

cards.name: Glacial Phantasm
cards.text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Glacial Phantasm is ready: Move it once toward the location with the most investigators. In player order, each investigator at Glacial Phantasm's location or a connecting location shuffles the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into their deck without looking at it (each investigator who cannot takes 1 horror).
cards.text_cn: 強制 – 當敵軍階段結束時，如果冰川幻影處於準備狀態：將其向調查員最多的地點移動一次。按玩家順序，每位在冰川幻影所在地點或連接地點的調查員，將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌混洗入自己的牌堆，不要查看內容(每位不能這麼做的調查員受到1點恐懼)。

cards.name: Kindred Mist
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Kindred Mist attached. Forced - When 1 or more cards from the Tekeli-li deck would be shuffled into your deck while you are at attached location: Draw them instead, placing them on the bottom of your deck instead of the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. Discard Kindred Mist at the end of this round.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 疊加到最近且沒有疊加同源迷霧的地點。 強制 – 你位於被疊加的地點時，在1張或更多忒咳哩-哩牌堆的卡牌將要混洗入你的牌堆時：改為抽取那些卡牌，不要將它們放在忒咳哩-哩牌堆底，改為放在你的牌堆底。當一輪結束時丟棄同源迷霧。

cards.name: Antarctic Wind
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Antarctic Wind attached. Investigators at attached location cannot play cards or draw cards from their deck. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Antarctic Wind.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 疊加到最近且沒有疊加南極寒風的地點。位於被疊加地點的調查員不能打出卡牌，或從自己的牌堆抽取卡牌。 強制 – 當一輪結束時：丟棄南極寒風。

cards.name: Whiteout
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Each investigator at attached location gets -1 [willpower], -1 [intellect], -1 [combat], and -1 [agility]. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Whiteout.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 疊加到你所在地點。位於被疊加的地點的調查員得到–1[willpower]、–1 [intellect]、–1 [combat]、–1 [agility]。 強制 – 當一輪結束時：丟棄雪盲危機。

cards.name: Polar Vortex
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - When you end your turn at attached location: Each card you control with health (including your investigator) takes 1 direct damage. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Polar Vortex.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 疊加到你所在地點。 強制 – 在你在被疊加地點結束回合時：你控制的每張有生命值的卡牌(包括你的調查員)受到1點直接傷害。 強制 – 當一輪結束時：丟棄極地旋渦。

cards.name: Elder Thing Scavenger
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - After Elder Thing Scavenger attacks you: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. Draw each weakness discarded this way.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 – 在古老者清道夫攻擊你後：丟棄你牌堆頂3張卡牌。抽取所有以此方式棄掉的弱點。

cards.name: Guardian Elder Thing
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - When you deal damage to Guardian Elder Thing: For each point of damage dealt, discard the top card of your deck. Draw each weakness discarded this way.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 – 在你對古老者守衛造成傷害時：每造成1點傷害，丟棄你牌堆頂的1張卡牌。抽取所有以此方式棄掉的弱點。

cards.name: Rise of the Elder Things
cards.text: Revelation - Find the topmost [[Elder Thing]] enemy in the encounter discard pile and spawn it engaged with you. Each [[Elder Thing]] enemy currently engaged with you gets +1 fight and +1 evade until the end of the round. If Rise of the Elder Things put no enemies into play, it gains surge.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 找出遭遇棄牌堆最頂部的一張[[古老者]]敵人，並將其生成，與你交戰。當前與你交戰的每個[[古老者]]敵人得到+1攻擊和+1躲避，直到本輪結束。如果古老者崛起沒有放置敵人入場，其獲得湧動。

cards.name: Ice Shaft
cards.text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). For each [frost] token revealed during this test, take 1 damage. If you fail, take 2 damage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 檢定[agility](3)。本次檢定期間每抽出一個[frost]標記，受到1點傷害。如果你檢定失敗，受到2點傷害。

cards.name: Through the Ice
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location without a copy of Through the Ice attached. As an additional cost for you to enter or leave attached location (except by a scenario card effect), test [agility] (2). If you fail, cancel the effects of the move, take 1 damage and 1 horror, and discard Through the Ice.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 疊加到最近且沒有疊加穿越冰雪的地點。 做為你進入或離開被疊加地點(除因冒險卡牌效果外)的額外費用，檢定[agility](2)。如果你檢定失敗，取消本次移動的效果，受到1點傷害和1點恐懼，並丟棄穿越冰雪。

cards.name: Lost Researcher
cards.text: Spawn - Any location (empty, if able). Lost Researcher enters play with 1 doom on it. Forced - When Lost Researcher is defeated: Move each doom on it to its location. [action]: Parley. Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, take control of 1 doom on Lost Researcher and flip it to its clue side. Then, if there is no doom on Lost Researcher, discard it.
cards.text_cn: 生成 – 任意地點(如可能，則生成在無人地點)。 迷失的研究員入場時，帶有1個毀滅標記。 強制 – 在迷失的研究員被擊敗時：將其上的所有毀滅標記移動到其所在地點。 [action]：談判。檢定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你檢定成功，控制迷失的研究員上的1個毀滅標記並將其翻至線索面。然後，如果迷失的研究員上沒有毀滅標記，將其丟棄。

cards.name: Frenzied Explorer
cards.text: Frenzied Explorer enters play with 1 doom on it. Forced - When Frenzied Explorer is defeated: Move each doom on it to its location. [reaction] After you successfully evade Frenzied Explorer by 2 or more: Take control of 1 doom on Frenzied Explorer and flip it to its clue side. Then, if there is no doom on Frenzied Explorer, discard it.
cards.text_cn: 狂亂的探險家入場時，帶有1個毀滅標記。 強制 – 在狂亂的探險家被擊敗時：將其上的所有毀滅標記移動到其所在地點。 [reaction]在你成功躲避狂亂的探險家，且超過難度至少2點後：控制狂亂的探險家上的1個毀滅標記並將其翻至線索面。然後，如果狂亂的探險家上沒有毀滅標記，將其丟棄。

cards.name: Abandoned to Madness
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest [[Possessed]] enemy and place 1 doom on that enemy. If there are no [[Possessed]] enemies in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a [[Possessed]] enemy, draw it, and attach Abandoned to Madness to it (shuffle the encounter deck). Increase the difficulty to fight, evade, or parley with attached enemy by 1.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 疊加到最近的[[附身]]敵人，並在該敵人上放置1個毀滅標記。如果場上沒有[[附身]]敵人，查找遭遇牌堆及棄牌堆，找出並抽取一個[[附身]]敵人，並將身陷瘋狂疊加到該敵人(混洗遭遇牌堆)。 攻擊、躲避或與該敵人談判的難度增加1。

cards.name: Blasphemous Visions
cards.text: Revelation - Shuffle the top card of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at it. Then, put Blasphemous Visions into play in your threat area. Resolve the effects of each Tekeli-li weakness you draw an additional time. [action]: Test [willpower] (3). If you succeed, discard Blasphemous Visions.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，不要查看內容。然後，將瀆神幻象放置入場，放到你的威脅區域。 額外結算一次你抽取到的所有忒咳哩-哩弱點的效果。 [action]：檢定[willpower](3)。如果你檢定成功，丟棄瀆神幻象。

cards.name: Glimpse the Unspeakable
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - Draw the top card of the Tekeli-li deck (and resolve its effects). Shuffle it into any investigator's deck instead of placing it on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. If no Tekeli-li weakness is drawn by this effect, Glimpse the Unspeakable gains surge.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 – 抽取忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌(並結算其效果)。不要將其放到忒咳哩-哩牌堆底，改為混洗入任意一位調查員的牌堆。如果沒有以此效果抽取忒咳哩-哩弱點，窺看不可說之事獲得湧動。

cards.name: Nightmarish Vapors
cards.text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Lose 2 actions. - Shuffle the top 2 cards of the Tekeli-li deck into your deck without looking at them.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 – 你必須(選擇一項)： - 失去2個行動。 - 將忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的2張卡牌混洗入你的牌堆，不要查看內容。

cards.name: Miasmatic Torment
cards.text: Revelation - If you control a partner asset, exhaust them and attach Miasmatic Torment to them. Otherwise, Miasmatic Torment gains surge. Attached asset cannot ready. Forced - At the end of your turn: Attached asset takes 1 damage or 1 horror. [action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3). If you succeed, discard Miasmatic Torment.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 – 如果你控制夥伴支援，將其消耗，並將瘴氣折磨疊加到該支援。否則，瘴氣折磨獲得湧動。 被疊加的支援不能準備。 強制 – 當你的回合結束時：被疊加的支援受到1點傷害或1點恐懼。 [action]：檢定[willpower]或[intellect](3)。如果你檢定成功，丟棄瘴氣折磨。

cards.name: Nebulous Miasma
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to your location. Forced - When you end your turn at attached location: Each card you control with sanity (including your investigator) takes 1 direct horror. Forced - At the end of the round: Discard Nebulous Miasma.
cards.text_cn: 禍害。 顯現 – 疊加到你所在地點。 強制 – 在你在被疊加地點結束回合時：你控制的每張有神智值的卡牌(包括你的調查員)受到1點直接恐懼。 強制 – 當一輪結束時：丟棄朦朧瘴氣。

cards.name: Giant Albino Penguin
cards.text:
Aloof.
As an additional cost for you to enter or leave this enemy's location, you must spend 1 action.
cards.text_cn:
冷漠。
作為進入或離開本敵人所在地點的額外費用，你必須花費1個行動。

cards.name: Wuk! Wuk! Wuk!
cards.text: Revelation - Find the Giant Albino Penguin enemy farthest from you. You must either move it to your location or place 1 doom on it. If there are no Giant Albino Penguins in play, search the encounter deck and discard pile for a Giant Albino Penguin, draw it, and shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 找到離你最遠的巨型白化企鵝敵人。你必須將其移動到你所在地點，或在其上放置1個毀滅標記。如果場上沒有巨型白化企鵝，查找遭遇牌堆和棄牌堆，找出並抽取一個巨型白化企鵝，並混洗遭遇牌堆。

cards.name: Forgotten Shoggoth
cards.text: Hunter. Forced - After Forgotten Shoggoth engages you: Draw the top card of the Tekeli-li deck (if you cannot, Forgotten Shoggoth attacks you).
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 強制 – 在失落的修格斯與你交戰後：抽取忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌(如果你不能這麼做，失落的修格斯攻擊你)。

cards.name: Rampaging Shoggoth
cards.text: Hunter. Massive. Rampaging Shoggoth gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Deal 2 damage to each investigator and non-[[Shoggoth]] enemy at Rampaging Shoggoth's location. Each of those investigators draws the top card of the Tekeli-li deck.
cards.text_cn: 獵手。 龐大。 狂暴的修格斯擁有+2[per_investigator]生命值。 強制 – 當敵軍階段結束時：對狂暴的修格斯所在地點的每位調查員和每個非[[修格斯]]敵人造成2點傷害。這些調查員各自抽取忒咳哩-哩牌堆頂的1張卡牌。

cards.name: Polar Mirage
cards.text: Revelation - Attach to the nearest location with at least 1 clue, and without a copy of Polar Mirage attached. Forced - After you discover or take control of 1 or more clues at attached location: Discard each non-weakness card in your hand. Discard Polar Mirage.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 疊加到最近的有線索且沒有疊加極地幻景的地點。 強制 – 在你發現或控制被疊加地點的線索後：丟棄你手中所有非弱點卡牌。丟棄極地幻景。

cards.name: Dark Aurora
cards.text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (3). For each [frost] token revealed during this test, take 1 horror. If you fail, take 2 horror.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 – 檢定[willpower](3)。本次檢定期間每抽出一個[frost]標記，受到1點恐懼。如果你檢定失敗，受到2點恐懼。

cards.name: Professor William Dyer
cards.text:
Partner. Uses (3 secrets).
[action] Spend 1 secret and exhaust Professor William Dyer: Heal 2 horror from an investigator or another [[Ally]] asset at your location.
cards.text_cn:
夥伴。使用(3秘密)。
[action]花費1秘密並消耗威廉·戴爾教授：治癒你所在地點的一位調查員或另一個[[盟友]]支援2點恐懼。

cards.name: Danforth
cards.text:
Partner. Uses (5 secrets).
[reaction] After an investigator at your location resolves a Tekeli-li weakness, exhaust Danforth and spend 1 secret: That investigator draws 2 cards.
cards.text_cn:
夥伴。使用(5秘密)。
[reaction]在你所在地點的一位調查員結算忒咳哩-哩弱點後，消耗丹佛斯並花費1秘密：該調查員抽取2張卡牌。

cards.name: Eliyah Ashevak
cards.text: Partner. Uses (3 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret and exhaust Eliyah Ashevak: Evade. Attempt to evade with a base [agility] skill of 5. If you succeed, you may move to a connecting location.
cards.text_cn: 夥伴。使用(3秘密)。 [action]花費1秘密並消耗伊里亞·阿什瓦克：躲避。以基礎[agility]值為5的躲避嘗試。如果你檢定成功，你可以移動到一個連接地點。

cards.name: Dr. Mala Sinha
cards.text:
Partner. Uses (3 supplies).
[action] Spend 1 supply and exhaust Dr. Mala Sinha: Heal 2 damage from an investigator or another [[Ally]] asset at your location.
cards.text_cn:
夥伴。使用(3補給)。
[action]花費1補給並消耗瑪拉·辛哈醫生：治癒你所在地點的一位調查員或另一個[[盟友]]支援2點傷害。

cards.name: Avery Claypool
cards.text:
Partner. Uses (5 supplies).
[reaction] When an investigator at your location reveals a [frost] token during a skill test, exhaust Avery Claypool and spend 1 supply: Cancel that token and reveal a new one.
cards.text_cn:
夥伴。使用(5補給)。
[reaction]技能檢定期間，在你所在地點的一位調查員抽出一個[frost]標記時，消耗艾弗里·克萊普爾並花費1補給：取消該標記並抽出一個新的標記。

cards.name: James "Cookie" Fredericks
cards.name_cn: 詹姆斯·"曲奇"·弗雷德里克斯
cards.text: Partner. Uses (3 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo and exhaust James "Cookie" Fredericks: Fight. Fight with a base [combat] skill of 5. If you succeed and the attacked enemy is non-[[Elite]], it cannot attack for the remainder of the round.
cards.text_cn: 夥伴。使用(3子彈)。 [action] 花費1子彈並消耗詹姆斯·"曲奇"·弗雷德里克斯：攻擊。以基礎[combat]值為5的攻擊。如果你檢定成功，且被攻擊的敵人非[[精英]]，則直到本輪結束其不能攻擊。

cards.name: Dr. Amy Kensler
cards.text: Partner. Uses (3 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret and exhaust Dr. Amy Kensler: Investigate. Investigate with a base [intellect] skill of 5. If you succeed, look at the top card of any investigator's deck or the encounter deck. You may discard that card.
cards.text_cn: 夥伴。使用(3秘密)。 [action]花費1秘密並消耗艾米·肯斯勒博士：調查。以基礎[intellect]值為5的調查。如果你檢定成功，查看任意一位調查員牌堆頂的1張卡牌或遭遇牌堆頂的1張卡牌。你可以丟棄該卡牌。

cards.name: Roald Ellsworth
cards.text:
Partner. Uses (5 supplies).
[fast] During an investigator's turn, exhaust Roald Ellsworth and spend 1 supply: Choose a treachery attached to any location. Treat that treachery's text box as if it were blank until the end of this turn.
cards.text_cn:
夥伴。使用(5補給)。
[fast]任意調查員回合期間，消耗羅爾德·埃爾斯沃思並花費1補給：選擇一張疊加到任意地點的詭計。將所選詭計的印刷文字方塊視為如同空白，直到本回合結束。

cards.name: Takada Hiroko
cards.text:
Partner. Uses (9 resources).
[action] Exhaust Takada Hiroko: Move up to 3 resources from Takada Hiroko to your resource pool.
cards.text_cn:
夥伴。使用(9資源)。
[action]消耗高田弘子：將高田弘子上的最多3資源移動到你的資源池。

cards.name: Tekeli-li
cards.text: Revelation - Take 1 horror. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 受到1點恐懼。將忒咳哩-哩放到忒咳哩-哩牌堆底。

cards.name: Tekeli-li
cards.text: Revelation - Take 1 damage. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 受到1點傷害。將忒咳哩-哩放到忒咳哩-哩牌堆底。

cards.name: Tekeli-li
cards.text: Revelation - Discard 1 card at random from your hand. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 隨機丟棄1張手牌。將忒咳哩-哩放到忒咳哩-哩牌堆底。

cards.name: Tekeli-li
cards.text: Revelation - Lose 2 resources. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 失去2資源。將忒咳哩-哩放到忒咳哩-哩牌堆底。

cards.name: Tekeli-li
cards.text: Revelation - If it is your turn, lose 1 action. Otherwise, lose 1 action during your next turn. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 如果現在是你的回合，失去1個行動。否則，你的下一個回合失去1個行動。將忒咳哩-哩放到忒咳哩-哩牌堆底。

cards.name: Tekeli-li
cards.text: Revelation - Place 1 of your clues on your location. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 將你的1個線索放到你所在地點。將忒咳哩-哩放到忒咳哩-哩牌堆底。

cards.name: Tekeli-li
cards.text: Revelation - Discard an asset you control. Place Tekeli-li on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck.
cards.text_cn: 顯現 - 丟棄你控制的一張支援。將忒咳哩-哩放到忒咳哩-哩牌堆底。

cards.name: Claypool's Furs
cards.text:
Fast.
[reaction] When you reveal a [frost] token during a skill test you are performing, deal 1 damage to Claypool's Furs: Cancel that chaos token and return it to the bag. Reveal a new chaos token.
cards.text_cn:
快速。
[reaction]你執行的技能檢定期間，在你抽出一個[frost]標記時，對克萊普爾的皮草造成1點傷害：取消該混亂標記並將其返回混亂袋。抽出一個新的混亂標記。

cards.name: Collected Works of Poe
cards.text:
Uses (3 charges).
[action] Spend 1 charge: Choose an investigator at your location to search the top 6 cards of their deck for each copy of Tekeli-li and place each of them on the bottom of the Tekeli-li deck. Shuffle that investigator's deck. That investigator draws 1 card.
cards.text_cn:
使用(3充能)。
[action]花費1充能：選擇你所在地點的一位調查員，其查找自己牌堆頂的6張卡牌，找出其中所有忒咳哩-哩，並將這些卡牌都放在忒咳哩-哩牌堆底。混洗該調查員的牌堆。該調查員抽取1張卡牌。

cards.name: Cookie's Custom .32
cards.text: Fast. Uses (2 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight. Either fight with a base [combat] skill of 5, or get +2 [combat] for this attack. This attack deals +1 damage.
cards.text_cn: 快速。 使用(2子彈)。 [action]花費1子彈：攻擊。以基礎[combat]值為5的攻擊，或者本次攻擊得到+2[combat]。本次攻擊造成+1點傷害。

cards.name: Dyer's Sketches
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Draw 3 cards.
cards.text_cn:
快速。可在任何[fast]時間段期間打出。
抽取3張卡牌。

cards.name: Ellsworth's Boots
cards.text:
Limit 1 [[Footwear]] per investigator.
[reaction] After the last clue is discovered from your location, exhaust Ellsworth's Boots: Move to a connecting location, or discard Ellsworth's Boots to move to any revealed location.
cards.text_cn:
每位調查員限制1張[[鞋子]]。
[reaction]在你所在地點的最後一個線索被發現後，消耗埃爾斯沃思的靴子：移動到一個連接地點，或者丟棄埃爾斯沃思的靴子來移動到任意一個已揭示地點。

cards.name: Kensler's Log
cards.text: Fast. Uses (2 secrets). [action] Spend 1 secret: Investigate. Either investigate with a base [intellect] skill of 5, or get +2 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, you discover 1 additional clue at your location.
cards.text_cn: 快速。使用(2秘密)。 [action]花費1秘密：調查。以基礎[intellect]值為5的調查，或者本次調查得到+2[intellect]。如果你檢定成功，發現你所在地點額外1個線索。

cards.name: Sinha's Medical Kit
cards.text:
Uses (3 supplies).
[fast] Exhaust Sinha's Medical Kit and spend 1 supply: Heal 1 damage or 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location.
cards.text_cn:
使用(3補給)。
[fast]消耗辛哈的醫藥箱並花費1補給：治癒你所在地點的一位調查員或一個[[盟友]]支援的1點傷害或1點恐懼。

cards.name: Takada's Cache
cards.text:
Fast. Play during any [fast] window.
Gain 3 resources and draw 1 card. Remove Takada's Cache from the game.
cards.text_cn:
快速。可在任何[fast]時間段期間打出。
獲得3資源並抽取1張卡牌。將高田的物品從遊戲中移除。

cards.name: Anyu
cards.text: [fast] Exhaust Anyu: Choose one, or discard Anyu to choose up to three, in any order - - Move to a connecting location. - You get +2 skill value for your next skill test this round. - Evade. Attempt to evade with a base [agility] skill of 4.
cards.text_cn: [fast]消耗安雨：選擇一項，或丟棄安雨來選擇最多三項(以任意順序)—— - 移動到一個連接地點。 - 本輪下次技能檢定中你得到技能值+2。 - 躲避。以基礎[agility]值為4的躲避嘗試。
